tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyor drug gi ngo sprod yid kyi rol mtsho bzhugs/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim sbyor ba yan lag drug gi ngo sprod yid kyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo| |don dam gnas lugs spros pa nyer zhi'i mkha' dbyings cher/ /tha snyad gnas lugs zla nyi sgra dus thig le bzhi/ /gnas skabs bzhi yis rdul dang sprin gyis sgrib pa las/ /legs par sbyangs nas dpal ldan sku bzhir bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /lam mchog bsnyen bsgrub rdo rje bzhi la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /bde gshegs mi 'gyur bde chen mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba'i/ kha sbyor mchog gyur stong gzugs ye shes skur bzhengs pa/ /rang rang skal ldan la snang dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ /lam mchog de yis 'gro la phan bde bsgrub/ /bdag yid brtan la ngal bso'i mchog stsal nas/ /legs bshad mthar thug mgrin pa'i do shal du/ /sbyin mdzad bla ma mchog la gus phyag 'tshal/ /gang gis zhabs pad gus bsten pas/ /bdag blo dbyar gyi chu bzhin du/ /rgyas mdzad rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /bdag gi spyi bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /'di ni zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la/ /phal cher mos min mos shing 'jug rnams la| |lam ltar bcos pas g.yengs pa mang mthong nas/ /brtse bas ji bzhin gnas pa 'dir bshad bya/ /de la 'dir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bar bya ba dman 'bring mchog gi 'jug pa la ltos nas chags bral dang*/ sa dang phar phyin dang 'dod chags kyi spyod pa ste/ spyod pa'i tshul gsum la sogs pa dngos bstan gyi lam la dman 'bring mchog gsum mang du gsungs pa'i mchog gi mchog ni dbang bzhi pa'i mthar thug gi lam sbyor ba yan lag drug pa nyid yin la/ de yang bla med gzhan du yang 'byung zhing*/ khyad par dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma'am le'u bco brgyad pa las rgyas par 'byung ba/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas le'u bcu gnyis pa'i bsnyen bsgrub bzhi'i thad du drangs nas rgyas par bkral zhing*/

nā ro pas rgyud phyi ma nyid kyi 'grel par bshad pa'i don gsang 'dus 'phags pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim rim pa lnga dang phan tshun bsdu tshul rgyas par byas nas dus 'khor dang sbyor drug gi ming tsam mthun gyis/ mtshan nyid phal cher mi mthun par mkhas pa dag bzhed pa'i/ slob pa'i zung 'jug dang*/ 'di'i ting nge 'dzin 'phags lam du gnyis kyang 'gyur bde dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i khyad yod pa lta bu ni dngos bstan gyi lam la dman mchog byung ba'i khyad kyis yin zhing*/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la de skyed mi skyed kyi nus pa'i khyad yod pa ni dgos mod kyang*/ smon lam du zung 'jug ting nge 'dzin zhes gcig nyid du byas shing*/ rim lnga'i 'od gsal gyi lugs bzlog rjes dran dang*/ sems dben dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal te gsum ka 'dzin par 'dod pa sogs ni/ rgyu mtshan 'thad ldan mi snang bas/ lus dben gyis sor bsam bsdus pa bzhin tu/ ngag dben gyis srog rtsol dang*/ sems dben gyis 'dzin pa dang*/ sgyu lus ni rjes dran dang*/ 'od zung ni ting nge 'dzin du bsdus na don dang mthun la/ dngos bstan gyi dbang du byas na rim lngas ni sbyor drug gi rtogs pa yongs su mi rdzogs la/ 'di'i sbyor drug gis ni rim lnga'i rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs so zhes brjod par bya'o/ / de ltar na lugs 'di gnyis bskyed rim gyi 'gros tha dad pa bzhin du rdzogs rim gyi lam 'gros kyang cung zad mi 'dra bar grub la/ bde mchog lu i pa'i bskyed rim gyi 'gros dang mthun pa'i rdzogs rim ni rnal 'byor chen po nyid dang*| de nyid tshul cung zad mi mthun kyang nus pa gcig pas sgrub pa dril bu rim lnga pa'o/ /'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi skyed rim dang 'gros mthun pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ bde mchog mngon brjod bla ma dang sdom 'byung sogs las 'byung ba zhal lung dang grol thig gis ston pa rim pa bzhi par grags shing grub chen nag po spyod pas o la pa ti dang dpyid thig dang gsang ba'i de kho na nyid la sogs par bshad pa'o/

/de ltar na chos 'di ni/ ya mtshan can du grags pa'i man ngag phyi rol pa'i a tsa ra'i lag nas gser gyis bslus pa dang*/ brag 'og nas gter bton pa dang*/ gang zag bzang por grags pa'i nyams snang dang*/ rmi lam du brnyed pa la sogs pa'i man ngag ma yin pas da ltar gy-i gang zag phal cher don du mi gnyer mod na'ang ston pa/ bstan pa 'di'i bdag po shākya thub pas/ gdul bya thun mong ba thams cad theg pa gsum dang 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyis btul tshar nas/ dus mya ngan las 'das ka'i lo gcig gi sngon rol du/ gnas rgya gar lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen po'i steng du dpal ldan sgyu skar dang 'og tu chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul te/ 'khor sa bcu'i byang sems zla ba bzang po la sogs pa skal ba dang ldan pa'i dbus su chos dbyings seng ge'i khri la mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam rol du bstan nas gsungs*/ dpal ldan shaṃ bha la'i chos rgyal sa bcu'i byang sems kyis legs par bkral zhing rim par bsdus te rgyun ma chad par bshad/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa dang dus zhabs pa la sogs pas 'phags pa'i yul du nan tan gyis slangs/ dpal mgon klu sgrub kyi dngos slob grub chen shwa ba ri dbang phyug dang*/ gzhan yang dpe med mtsho dang*| jo bo chen po dang*/ nā ro pa chen po dang*/ mkhas pa a bha yā ka ra dang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī la sogs pas thugs nyams su bzhes shing gtan la dbab/ bod kyi lo tsā ba/ rwa chos rab dang*/ 'bro shes rab grags dang*/ seng dkar shākya grags dang*/ rtswa mi gyi jo dang*/ mkhas pa shong dpang la sogs pas bsgyur cing bcos/ ra 'bro'i mkhas grub gong ma du ma dang*/ khyad par mkhas pa chen po 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer dang*/ man lungs gu ru la sogs pas nyams su blangs bas bde blag tu grub pa thob/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis legs par bsngags shing bskyed rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs ci rigs pa mdzad/

khyad par gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bu ston chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ chos rje bla ma dam pas legs par rtsal du ston nas bshad bsgrub kyi bstan pa brtsugs shing*| dpal jo mo nang pa yab sras kyang 'di kho na gtso bor mdzad/ phyis kyi chos rje rnam pa gsum kas log rtogs bsal ba dang*/ bshad sgrub kyi rnam bzhag du ma mdzad pa'i gsungs rab chen po/ che reg na che 'tshengs/ chung reg na'ang chung 'tshengs pa/ mdor na/ rgyal bas gsungs/ paṇa grub kyis bkral/ lo paṇa gyis bsgyur/ mkhas pas gces spras su byas/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ byin brlabs kyi drod ma yal/ gdam ngag gi sar kha ma logadam tshig gi sel ma bzhugs pa'i nyams len khyad par can yin no/ /de'i gzhi lam 'bras gsum phyi nang gzhan gsum/ khyad par smin byed dbang gi rnam gzhag cha lag dang bcas pa dang*/ lam gyi bskyed rim lag len dang bcas pa gzhan du rgyas par bshad zin/ rdzogs rim gyi yang nyams len dmigs rim khyad par can zur du bkod tshar bas 'dir de dag gi yid ches bskyed pa'i thabs brjod par bya'o| | de yang yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir dang*/ brgyud pa la gces spras su bya ba'i phyir du bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus brjod pa sngon du btang bar bzhed pa bzhin du cis kyang rigs pa las/ rwa 'bro shong gsum gyi bla ma'i rnam thar rgyas pa spyi don chen mor bkod tshar bas/ 'dir lugs tha dad gzhan rnams gang nas brgyud pa dang de dag gi rnam thar bsdus pa brjod par bya'o/ / de la dang por grub chen dpe med mtsho'i rgya skad a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta'i sbyor drug gi rgyud pa'i rtsa ba grub chen de nyid ni/ phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la thugs legs par sbyangs te/ mthar khas+sar+pa ṇa'i drung du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ rtsā'i 'dab ma lags pa'i bcud len la rten/ g.yeng ba thams cad spangs nas dmigs med kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms kyang rtogs pa'i khyad par ma thob pas thugs chad rnal du song ba na/

rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ bi kra ma su rar song shig der rtogs pa'i khyad par legs par sbyangs pa skye'o zhes lung bstan thob nas rang gi slob ma paṇa chen legs pa'i bu dpal 'dzin phyag phyir khrid de byon/ thugs dam la bzhugs pas mtshan phyed kyi dus su rdo rje 'chang nyid ā ba dhū tī'i cha byad du byon nas gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang*/ kye rigs kyi bu 'di ni de kho na nyid do zhes gsung ma thag tu mngon sum du rtogs/ bcom ldan 'das kyang de nyid du mi snang bar gyur/ mtshan mo de 'das pa dang*/ bram ze chen po dpal 'dzin des kyang dka' ba dpag med kyis zhabs tog mdzad pas byin brlabs zhugs shing snod ldan du dgongs nas rang gi rtogs pa de la gnang ngo*/ /des kyang skal ba mchog dang ldan pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'od byed lha la gnang*/ des rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang phyug chos 'byung zhi ba la/ des bla ma bsten pa la mkhas shing gnas lnga rig pa/ grub chen nyi ma dpal ye shes sam/ rgya skad ra wi shrī dzñā na la/ des dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing rtse gcig tu ting nge 'dzin la gzhol ba rin chen mtsho'am/ rgya skad rat+na rak+ṣi ta la/ des kha che paṇa chen gyi paṇa chung mchog tu gyur pa mkhas grub bi bhū tī tsan+t+ra'am rnal 'byor pa zla ba la gnang*/ yang na chos 'byung zhi bas paṇa chen grags pa'i lha/ des dharmā dā pa'am chos kyi 'bangs/ de la'ang bi bhū tis gsan/ 'dis bod du lan gsum byon/ mang po la gnang yang gtso bo grub chen ko brag pa/ g.yung phug pa/ nyag po chos ldan gsum la gnang*/ de gsum ka la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs pa go lung pa gzhon nu dpal gyis gsan/ de la gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas mchog khyad par rgyud sde mtha' dag thugs su chud cing mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag med mnga' ba/

rgya gar shar nub dbus gsum du bod kyi btsun gcig mar grags pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa thar lo nyi ma rgyan mtshan gyis gsan/ de la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i bstan 'dzin chen po bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ de la mkhyen brtse phrin las kyi yon tan brjod kyi mi lang yang khengs pa dang rlom pa rdul tsam yang mi mnga' ba'i rgyal ba gnyis pa chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de la jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam 'phrul du gdon mi za ba lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can/ de la de'i sras kyi thu bo rngog legs she'am spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar du lung bstan pa sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i drung du bdag gis rgyud 'grel man ngag rdzogs par thob la/ brgyud pa 'di la lugs gzhan rnams kyang tshang ste/ bla ma go lung pa des/ rwa lugs kyi paṇa chen mañdzu kīrti'i slob ma sa man+ta shrī bha tra la dngos su gsan pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /sha ba ri dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i nye brgyud ni/ grub chen de'i rnam thar/ te te'i gar mkhan lo ki dang gu na gnyis kyi bu tsha/ rigs ngan glu gar gyis mtsho ba ming sring gsum yod pa/ baṃ ga la'i dgon pa na dpal mgon klu sgrub bzhugs par slong du phyin pas/ snod ldan du gzigs nas nang du bos te bza' btung mang du byin| dad pa thob/ slob dpon gyi dngos kyi bla ma byang sems blo gros rin chen du grags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi ras bris yod pa mthong nas 'di ci lags zhus pas| |lha'i byang sems mi phal pas mi mthong pa gcig yin gsungs pas// bdag la yang bstan par zhu zer/ 'o na spyi gtsug na bzhugs kyi ltos shig gsungs pas/ de mthong ba'i mig gcig gnang par zhu zer/ bde mchog gi dbang bskur nas bsgrub tu bcug pas/ rgyud dag byang sems kyi zhal mthong*/ sa ra ha'i do ha glu ru blangs nas mchod pa phul bas/ byang sems blo gros rin chen gyi zhal nas de'i don shes sam gsung mi shes lags zhus pas/

byin gyis brlabs| don bstan pas de nyid du don mngon sum du rtogs so/ /de nas byang sems kyi zhal nas/ khyod lho phyogs ldong ngar gyi ston pa shwa ba ri dbang phyug tu grags par 'gyur bas/ rngon pa'i chas su zhugs la/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri/ sems ngal bso/ yid pham par byed pa'i ri la song nas dbang po yang rab kyi don gyis shig ces lung bstan pa bzhin mdzad de/ deng sang gi bar du bzhugs shing gang zag khyad par can dang mjal ba'ang 'byung bas/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen pas kyang mjal/ sbyor drug gsan par grags la/ paṇa chen 'di la bdag gis kyang rdo rje'i tshig gcig thob bo/ /grub chen shwa ba ri de la/ paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsaṇ+ḍas gsan/ 'di ni rgya gar shar phyogs wa ren+t+ra pa/ dgos dza ga dha pa yin| mang bkur sde la rab tu byung*/ theg pa che chung rig pa'i gnas lnga la legs par sbyangs thugs nyams su bzhes pas 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa yi dam dang grub chen mang po gzigs pa'i skabs gcigathang bi ha ra na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa lang tsho dar la bab pa ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ri'i lpags pa smad la dkris pa gcig byon nas 'dir zhag 'ga' sdod pa yin gsung*/ sgra'i slob gnyer ba 'dra'i zla la bzhag pas de rnams kyis rnal 'byor pa bzang por go nas bla ma la zhus pas/ nang du spyan drangs dri ba zhus pas thogs med du byung*/ sha ba ri e yin zhus pas yin gsung nas tshogs 'khor dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ mdo rgyud mtha' dag gi bcud bsdus pa'i snying po gcig zhu zhus pas/ sbyor drug gi man ngag 'di gnang nas/ kha che dang dpal gyi ri la las can gyi gdul bya yod pas 'gro gsung nas bshegs so/ /de ltar rdo rje 'chang dang shwa ba ris rjes su bzung ba'i paṇa chen bi bhū ti la/ bod du grub chen ko brag pas kyang zhus shing*/ dpyal a mo ghas gtso bor zhus/ 'di la yon tan dpag med mnga'/

spyan ras gzigs kyis zhing khams pad+mo can du gshegs par lung bstan pas dpyal pad+mo can du grags so/ /de dang paṇa chen gnyis ka la mar ston g.yang 'bar gyis zhus/ 'di yang rlung dbu mar chud/ sangs rgyas mang po'i zhal gzigs gsal snang mngon shes dang 'dra bas dus gsum lung ston nus pa zhig go /de la rnal 'byor seng 'bum gyis zhus/ 'di gnas nges med thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad pas mngon shes mnga'/ stong gzugs kyi thig le'i nang du sangs rgyas dang de'i zhing khams mang po gzigs pa'o| |de la kun spangs chen po thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis zhus/ 'di 'khrungs yul byang nga phyar ba/ dgung lo lnga pa la chos rje sa paṇa la thugs bskyed zhus| 'phags pa rin po che la chos mang du gsan/ mkhas grub kyi bla ma mang du bsten| mdo sngags mtha' yas pa mkhyen/ kyang 'dur du phar tshad sogs kyi 'chad nyan yun ring mdzad/ khyad par rnal 'byor seng 'bum dang bla ma chos sku 'od zer la dus 'khor sbyor drug rgya bod na grags tshad/ brgyud pa so so'i lugs mi 'dra ba mtha' dag gsan/ 'chad nyan gyi tshe yang cung zad bsgoms pa tsam gyis nyams 'ur ba la sogs pa'i nyams myong bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyad par srog rtsol la dbang thob/ de'i sgo nas gdams ngag phog pa mang po grol/ sro lung pa'i srog rtsol rgyan can btsan thabs kyi man ngag thams cad 'dis mdzad| ma grongs pa nas bar do 'byongs te/ bar do na 'khyams pa mang po smin grol la bkod/ sku tshe la dbang thob/ gshegs khar byang sems rgyal ba ye shes gdan sar bskos/ khong 'cham pa bsnyung ba ma gdangs kyi bar la sku tshe bsrings nas bzhugs pa sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan dpag med mnga' khyad par dus 'khor sbyor drug gi sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ jo nang pa sgrub tshugs bzang bar grags pa yang 'di'i bka' drin no/ /'di la/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od kyis gsan nas bu ston nas brgyud pa'ang yod cing*/

chos rje bla ma dam pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rin chen dpal bzang dang*/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge gnyis kyis dngos su gsan zhing*/ sron pa chos dpal bzang pos sron pa kun rgyal brgyud nas gsan| de dag las rin dpal ba ni/ 'khrungs yul gsa' lung pa/ 'phags pa rin po che la thugs bskyed thob/

spyi lhas/ bo dong*/ brag ram sogs kyi mkhas pa mang po bsten/ lung rigs legs par mkhyen/ kun spangs chen po la sbyor drug mtha' dag gsan/ khong rang phar phyin la mkhas pas sgom khang du phar phyin dang sbyor drug sa mtshams sgrigs pas/ sang bla mas khyed de gnyis kyi sa mtshams sgrig pa las bsgoms na khe che ba yin te/ lar yang khyed kyis bsgoms byas na yon tan khyad par can yod par 'dug ste e byed mi shes gsungs pa ltar| chos rje sku mched la sogs chen po mang po'i 'gro don 'ba' zhig mdzad/ 'on kyang khengs pa cung zad kyang mi mnga'/ phyag rdzas gang byung chos phyogs su chags zhen med par gtong ba la sogs yon tan mtha' yas so// brag kha ba ni/ 'khrungs yul g.yas ru rgyal sde ba/ khro phu rin po che dang dbus pa sher 'bum/ bu ston seng ge 'od/ phya ru ba seṅge dpal la sogs pa mkhas grub mang du bsten/ rong pa rgal lo'i sras chung ba a ka ra la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel legs par gsan/ khyad par kun spangs chen po la sbyor drug gsan nas g.ya' lung dur khrod du bsgrubs pas legs par 'grub/ mkhas grub mang po dang bzhi thog mkhas btsun chen po khu dbon la sogs pa mang po'i don mdzad pa zhig go/ sron pa kun rgyal ni/ se chen rgyal po'i zu gur che ba yin/ 'phags pa rin po che dgyes nas 'di legs dbang yon la phul gsung nas bzhes/ phyag phyi 'thil ma bcol/ chos dang zang zing gis legs par bskyangs/ bla ma gshegs nas kun spangs chen por bsten/ sbyor drug bsgoms pas thugs dam dpag med 'khrungs| ra sa rin chen gling du stong gzugs kyi sha ba ri dbang phyug la chos gsan| spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs sogs las kyang chos dang gdam ngag mang du gsan pa zhig go /chos dpal ba yang*/ thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs| rlung gi yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' ba zhig go /de ltar kun rgyal ba ma gtogs gsum ka la chos rje bla ma dam pas sbyor drug lugs tha dad mtha' dag gsan zhing*/

mthar bu ston rin po che la ma lus pa gsan/ de la lo chen dang de la sems dpa' chen pos gsan pa'o/ /de yang lugs cung zad mi 'dra ba ni/ gtso bo 'grel pa skor gsum la rten pa/ rwa lugs/ 'bro lugs/ gyi jo lugs rnams dang*/ tsa mi rga lo nas brgyud pa lugs gsum/ dpe med mtsho dang sha ba ri nas brgyud pa la/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa lugs gsum| |bi bhū tī tsan+t+ra nas brgyud pa lugs bdun/ jo bo chen po dang*/ a bha ya nas brgyud pa sogs ste/ bu ston dang bla ma dam pa nas thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'o/ /sbyor drug ston par byed pa'i rgyud ni/ gtso bo mtshan brjod/ dbang mdor bstan yin pas/ lam 'di don du gnyer ba dag gis/ 'di gsum la kha don dang nges don gyi bshad pa la bslab par bya'o/ / bsdus rgyud kyi yang bsgrub le'u brgya bcu gnyis pa la sogs pa bcu lhag dang*/ mjug gi go sla phal cher dang*/ ye le'i brgya bcu bzhi pa la sogs pa bco lnga tsam dang*/ dbang le'i tshogs 'khor dang spyod pa'i bskor la sogs pa ste| nges don ston pa rnams zur du bkol ba/ rgyud kyi snying po zhes grags pa ti zur pa yod pa blo la bzung zhing*/ 'grel pa'ang gsum ka'i nges don skor dang*/ khyad par stod 'grel gyi sbyor drug gi skor la sbyang*/ gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs kyi lta ba mdor bstan/ spyan ras gzigs kyi don dam bsnyen pa/ gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma rtsa 'grel rnams la legs par bslab na ngo sprod kyi mchog tu 'gyur zhing nā ro paṇa chen la sogs pa rgya gar mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i nges pa brtan po rnyed la/ blo'i nus pa zhan pas re shig ma rnyed na yang byin brlabs 'jug tshabs gzhan las che bas/ man ngag byed pa yin zer nas gzhung chen po la sdang ba ni bstan pa snub par byed pa'i 'dre yin no// rgya gar paṇa grub kyi gzhung chung ni/

shwa ba ri/ dpe med mtsho/ tsi lu pa/ dus zhabs pa/ nyi ma dpal rnams kyi sbyor drug rigs gsum mgon po'i nyi zla bsgrub pa/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i snying po gsal ba/ 'di gnyis sems 'grel la gtogs kyang*/ nyung bas 'dir bsdus so/ /'dir rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa de dag gi bka' drin las/ gzhung lugs khyad par can de dag shes nas| snod ldan gyi gdul bya la bstan pa'i mthar thug dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam gyi snying po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ngo sprod pa la gsum ste/ gzhi gang nas/ lam gang gis/ 'bras bu gang du 'khrid pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang*/ /zhes mngon rtogs rgyan du gsungs pa dang mthun par dbang mdor bstan du/ rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams kyis/ /skye 'jig sgyu ma de bzhin no/ /'byung rnams 'jig par 'gyur min te| |rang bzhin nyid kyis skye mi 'gyur/ /sna tshogs dngos rnams rang bzhin med| |dngos dang dngos med rang bzhin can/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ chos rnams kyi don dam pa'i gnas lugs gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid don dam pa'i bden pa chos nyid de bzhin nyid du grags shing grub pa chos thams cad kyi steng na gdod ma nas bzhugs pa/ bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor nges pa'i don du gtso bor zhal gyis bzhes pa'i shing rta chen po dag gi dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems dang 'brel ba'i tshe rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs su grags pa 'di gzhi'i gtso bo yin kyang*/ spyir 'khor lo tha ma la lhag par mos shing*/ khyad par sems 'grel la mchog tu 'dzin pa dag gis/ phung po rnam bcad stong pa nyid/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med| |rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin// zhes pa'i lung 'ga' res 'khrul nas/ 'di 'dzin stangs kyi yul du ma byas pa'i blos 'khor ba'i rtsa ba chod par 'dod pa dag ni/

bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag dgos med du'am/ dgos pa chung ngu dang ldan par khas len dgos shing*/ bstan pa 'di'i ston pa dang shing rta chen po kun gyis bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gsungs pa dang ma mthun pa'i blo gros kyi 'jug pa ha cang thal ches pa yin pas bdag legs su 'dod pa dag gis bstan pa dang rang gzhan la brtse bas legs par dgag par rigs so/ /der ma zad/ 'khor lo bar pa man chad kyi gdul bya la cung zad sbas pa/ snying po mdo bcu sogs dang*/ rgyud sde rnams su je gsal du song ba'i gzhi'i zag med kyi sems dang*| rigs dang*/ khams dang*/ bde gshegs snying po dang*/ sangs rgyas myu gu dang*| chos khams dge ba zhes sogs dang*/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang gzhi'i rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems dang*| gzhom med kyi nā da dang*/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*/ 'od gsal bde chen dang*/ mkha'i shes rab dang*/ phyag rgya chen mo dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang*/ mchog gi dbang po zhes sogs kyis mdo sngags rim pa bzhin du gsungs pa/ tha snyad gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po'i sems 'di ni/ lam mchog tu gyur pa dag gi snang ba'i dmigs yul du gyur te/ lam dma' mo nas gnas lugs rags pa mngon sum du mthong bas ma dag las snang gi bzung 'dzin rags pa gcod cing*/ lam dang 'bras bu'i sku thugs gnyis ka'i nyer len nam sgrub gzhi ches phul du byung ba yin pa'i phyir| bde gshegs snying po 'am rang bzhin gnas rigs la chos nyid med dgag gis khyab par bzhed pa dag kyang mi 'thad pa chen po'au/ / 'o na bde gshegs snying po'i rnam gzhag gsal shos/ rgyud bla mar yang*| shes bya mthar thug rtogs pa'i blos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos nyid 'di| |sems can thams cad la yod par/ /mthong phyir ji snyed yod pa nyid// ces dang*/

sangs rgyas spyan gyis rang chos nyid gzigs nas/ zhes chos nyid du bshad pa dang*/ so so skye 'phags rdzogs sangs kyi/ /de bzhin nyid dbye'i 'jug pa la/ /de nyid gzigs pas sems can la/ /rgyal ba'i snying po 'di bstan no/ /zhes de bzhin nyid la dgongs gzhi byas pa dang*/ sngar ni de ltar rnam bzhag nas/ /slar yang bla ma'i rgyud 'dir ni/ /nyes pa lnga dag spang pa'i phyir| khams yod nyid ces bstan pa yin/ /zhes dgos pa pa la ltos pa'i drang don du gsungs pas gzhi'i chos can dngos por gyur pa de lta bu mi rigs so// zhes mkhas pa dag gsung pa ni/ mdo rgyud sems 'grel dang bcas pa'i dngos bstan bstan bya'i gtso bo mtha' dag drang don 'ba' zhig tu khas len dgos pas de dag gi dngos kyi gdul byar mi rung bar zad la/ rgyud bla rang na yang chos nyid kyi ming du gsungs pa'i khyed rang gi de tsam du zad la/ gzhan dpe dgu don dgu sogs skabs thams cad na ye shes sam/ shes pa'am/ rig pa sogs ma yin dgag tu gsungs pa sha stag dang 'gal zhing*/ khyed rang gis drangs pa'i lung snga ma nyid kyi rkang pa snga phyi 'gal te/ de mthong ba ji snyed pa mkhyen par bshad pa'i phyir/ des na chos nyid dang chos dbyings dang de bzhin nyid ces sogs ni gnas skabs pa'am tha snyad pa'i gnas lugs yin pa la dgongs shing rtag par gsungs pa thams cad rgyun rtag pa dang*/ zhi bar gsungs pa ngo bo zhi ba dang*/ bden pa'ang tha snyad du dpyad bzod pa sogs la dgongs par shes par bya zhing*/ 'di med na dngos por gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi nyer len nam sgrub gzhi med pas sangs rgyas phyi nas 'tshol dgos pa'i skyon shin tu che ste/ rgyas par spyi don chen mo'i mjug na gsal lo/ /de ltar na/ gtso bor phar phyin theg pa nas bshad pa'i chos nyid de bzhin nyid ni/ yul gyi gnas lugs yin pas/ 'di 'dzin stangs kyi yul du byas pa'i lam ni 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gcod pa la med du mi rung ste/

'di ltar snang grags kyi chos 'di thams cad yin lugs ming rkyang btags yod blos bzhag tsam las lhag pa'i grub tshul cung zad kyang med mod/ snang tshul de lta ma yin par tshugs thub tu yul rang ngos nas grub pa'i bdag gnyis su 'dzin pa 'di sems can thams cad la rang chas su yod cing*/ bden stong de bzhin nyid med dgag la dgrar ltas mdzad pa'i chen po dag la yang shin tu che bar 'dug pas/ 'di la 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i gnyen po med par du sogs kyi steng du rtog pa bkag pa'i har sgom gyis bden 'dzin gyi sa bon 'joms mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhi'i gtso bo bdag med rnam pa gnyis ni/ gsung rab mdo sngags mtha' dag gi thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bo dang*/ bsam don sgom bya'i gtso bor shes par bya'i/ sngon gyi rgya nag gi mkhan po dang*/ rdzogs chen phyag chen pa phal cher dang*/ khyad par lugs 'di la gtso bor bzung nas stong gzugs ma yin dgag nyid bsgom bya dang rtogs bya'i stong nyid yin gyi/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid 'di ni chad stong dang bem stong yin pas gtan la dbab bya tsam yang ma yin no zhes zer ba ni shin tu'ang tha chad la/ yu mo mi skyod rdo rjes/ de lta bas gtan la dbab bya tsam yin gyi bsgoms pas rgyud la bskyed bya ma yin no zhes zer ba'ang*/ thos bsam gzhan la byas nas nyams len gzhan du 'tshol bar 'gyur bas legs pa ma yin no/ /'o na de la dgongs nas/ phung po rnam gcad sogs dang*/ dngos dang dngos med kyi phyi sems kyi rdo rje dag kyang rnal 'byor pa la bde mnyam ster ma yin/ gang gi mkha' yi shes rab la 'khyud lhan skyes bde la gnas pa'i rang sems 'di ni thar pa ster/ /zhes sogs mang du bshad pa ci zhe na/ dbang gsum pa'i skabs su/ dbang bskur 'di ni ji ltar bar| |byang chub spyod gzhan de bzhin du/ /dge ba'i chos ni gzhan gsungs pa| |kun gyis sangs rgyas sogs mi 'thob/

/ces dang*/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs pas/ sbyin sogs dkar chos gzhan thams cad kyang spong dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de dag spong bar ston pa ma yin gyi/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa la tshogs sbyor gyi lam nges par dgos kyang tshogs sbyor rkyang pas sangs rgyas mi 'thob ces pa dang 'dra bar sbyin sogs dang phar phyin theg par gsungs pa'i lam rkyang pas mthar thug gi sangs rgyas mi 'grub pas dbang gsum pa'i lam mnan dgos so/ /zhes dgongs pa yin no zhe na/ shin tu legs pas 'dir yang de bzhin du 'don pa spos te/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i lam rnams kyi/ theg pa so so la ltos pa'i skyon can gyi bsam pa rnams dor te| yon tan mtha' dag gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du nges par khas blangs te/ re re rgyun du byas nas gzhan 'dor ba'i chos spong mi gyur ba ci nas kyang mdzad 'tshal lo/ /yang gang dag bka' 'khor lo tha ma rnams gsung rab kyi gtso bo shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod dang*/ rgyud bla ma sogs de'i dgongs 'grel mthar thug dang*/ rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par dus 'khor gsung rab kyi mthar thug tu khas len bzhin du bde gshegs snying po ma yin dgag la sdang ba dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i rlung 'od zer lnga pa sems can mtha' dag la yod par 'dod bzhin du dus 'khor la sgrub gzhi med pa dang*/ sor bsdud kyi dmigs pa gtod pa dhū ti'i yas snar nan gyis ched du gtad nas byed bzhin du de la snang ba'i stong gzugs phyi nas 'tshol bar 'dod pa rnams la ni dgag pa gzhan mi dgos te/ rang gis rang nyid rgyas par bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa de nyid shes rab phal pas yul du byas nas sgoms kyang dag pa'i mtshan ma mi snang zhing stong gzugs sam sgyu ma'i skur sdang mi srid pas/ rdo rje theg par bshad pa'i bde chen gyi yul byas nas sgoms pas de dang de 'grub pa ni lam gyi mthar thug yin la de'i yul gyi gtso bo 'dzin stangs kyi yul dang snang ba'i dmigs yul khyad par de gnyis gzhi'i gtso bor legs par grub cing*|

gzhi'i zag med kyi sems de la kun gzhi ye shes su gsungs pas de'i 'dzin stangs spros pa nyer zhi'i rnam ldan du gzhi dus nas yod cing ngo bo rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde chen du gnas pa ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi nyer len dang*| de'i zhen pa'am snang yul shin tu phra ba'i stong gzugs longs sku'i rnam ldan du gzhi dus nas yod pa ni sku'i nyer len te/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi sgrub gzhi mchog tu gyur pa rang la gzhi nas rang chas su yod pa/ dbang po dman 'bring gi byang sems la yang sbas pa rnams dbang po yang rab la gsal bar bstan te/ ngo ma shes pa'i za ma tog kha phye ba'am/ khang pa'i phugs kyi gter bstan pa la sogs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na 'di gnyis thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab bya dang*/ bsgoms pas mngon du 'gyur bya'i gzhi'i gtso bor shes par byas nas/ phung khams skye mched la sogs pa'i chos can ji snyed chos mngon pa sogs su gsungs pa rnams ni/ ma dag las snang can gyi 'khrul snang dang sgo bstun nas de la dge sdig rang sar snang ba rnams kyi blang dor dri mas dri ma 'khru ba'i tshul du gsungs pa/ 'jig rten ngor byas bdag ni smra bar byed/ /ces dang*| rnam dpyad med par 'jig rten nyid las 'di/ /zhes dang*/ ma brtag grags par gti mug las yin no/ /zhes dang*/ bden te 'on kyang rmongs las 'dod| |ces dang*/ 'bras bu'i don du khas blangs pa'i/ /rmongs pas brtags pa gang yin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'jig rten ngar 'dzin lhan skyes nyid kyi ngor ma brtag ma dpyad par 'khrul ngo dang rmongs ngo tsam du khas blangs par bya la| glo bur dri ma'i chos kyis bsdus pa'i spang gnyen tsam du shes nas/ dang por spang blangs la nan tan du 'bad dgos te/ rab rib can gyi rang la snang ba'i skra shad med par shes pa tsam gyis 'khrul snang ma log pa na/ med par shes pa de nyid mig sbyong ba'i rkyen du 'gro ba bzhin du las dang po pas 'khrul snang sbyong ba'i blang dor la 'bad dgos te/

de dag kyang gtan la dbab bya'i/ rags pa'am thog ma yin no/ /gzhi'i gtso bo de bzhin nyid ni sngon du lta ba btsal nas de'i rgyun skyong ba yin la/ chos can rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi rlung sems ni 'dir bsgom bya'i gzhi'i kun gzhi rgyu rgyud du grags pa 'khor 'das mtha' dag gi rtsa ba/ nā da'am ye shes zhes bya ste/ dri med 'od du/ 'dir sems can thams cad kyi snying gi nang na gnas pa ni ye shes so/ /de yang gzhom du med pa'i sgra ste rtag tu nā da'i mtshan nyid do/ zhes so/ 'di la bu ston rin po ches ma rig pa gzhom med ces ming btags nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis 'joms par gsung pa ni/ ye shes su gsungs pa 'di dang 'gal zhing thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpar bshad pa dang 'gal te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis bcom nas tha ma byung bas so/ /des na gzhi la kun gzhi ye shes dang rnam shes gnyis su byas nas 'di ni ye shes te/ ngo bo dri ma dang bral ba'i zag med/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi dngos rgyu yin la/ 'di'i steng na 'gyur med gzhom med kyi thig le bzhi gnas pa ni sku rdo rje bzhi'i sgrub gzhi'o/ /de dag ni lam gang gis kyang gzhom mi nus shing gzhom med ces bya'i/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs pas dpyad gzod pa dang gzhom mi nus pa'i bden grub kyang ma yin no// 'di dang ngo bo dbyer yod cing 'bral nges yin kyang da lta chu dang rnyog pa ltar dbyer med du 'dres nas gnas pa snga ma las cung zad rags pa dri mas sbags pa'i rnam shes phra ba ni kun gzhi rnam shes te/ de'i steng gi 'gyur bcas kyi thig le bzhi las sad rmi gnyid 'thug bzhi pa'i gnas skabs te gnas skabs bzhi bskyed la/ ye shes dang rnam shes sbyar ba'i steng nas pha las thob pa'i dkar cha dang*| 'og na ma las thob pa'i dmar cha tsheg drag gaṃ me ri zhes bya/ de nas 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi rlung brgyus pas me ri bskyod nas snying kha'i nā da yang bskyod par byed/

des yul 'dzin pa'i rnam shes rtog med rtog bcas dang de las nyon mongs dang des las bsags te/ thun mong bas snod dang*/ de min gyi bcud 'grub par byed cing*/ rlung 'pho chen bcu gnyis su rgyu bas dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi snang ba phyi nang du grub nas lam bden don bcu gnyis kyi sbyang gzhi 'grub la/ rlung sems rags pa'i snang ba srid pa'i bag chags sad nas nyi mas zla ba bzhus pa'i dga' ba bcu drug 'char/ lam de nyid rnam pa bcu drug gi sbyang gzhi rnams 'grub/ de ltar khams 'gyur zhing 'dzags pas chags pa dang bral nas zhe sdang dang de las sems rmongs shing rgyal ba'i gti mug tu 'gyur zhing de las 'du byed la sogs pa'i rten 'brel gzhan rnams 'byung ste srid pa'i 'khor lo bar ma chad du 'khor zhing nam zhig las tshar gcig gi 'phen pa zad nas 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe ni/ rlung sems rags pa 'gags nas thabs mkhas dang bral ba'i dbang gis me gyen du 'bar zhing chu 'thur la lhag ma med par babs me bsres zla nyi kha sbyor zhig pa na rnam shes las gzhan gyi 'phen pas 'phangs te/ dar gyi srin bu bzhin du yon tan brgyad kyi kha chu phra bas bcings nas bar do 'grub la/ des mngal bzung ba na slar yang zla nyi kha sbyar gyi dbus su yon tan rags pa brgyad kyis bcings nas rim gyis mngon par 'phel tshul rgyas par nang le'e spyi don du bshad zin to/ lam gang gis 'khrid pa la/ lam gyi gtso bo ni/ bzhi pa'i lam zung 'jug ste/ sku rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs kun rdzob bden pas sgyu ma'i lus dang*/ thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen don dam bden par btags pa 'od gsal gyi sems gnyis ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis dbyer med dang 'bral med zung du 'jug pa rgyu la 'bras bu dang 'bras bu la rgyus rgyas btab pa ste/ dbang mdor bstan du/ stong pa gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa rgyu/
/snying rje 'gyur med 'dzin pa 'bras/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems su de brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang gtso bor rjes dran gyi stong gzugs dang*/

de'i dngos 'bras ting nge 'dzin skad cig dang po gnyis rgyus yin pas rgyu dang 'bras bur bshad la/ de yan chad nas phan tshun rgyas gtab pa ste| zung 'jug tu bsgrub pas na lam gyi gtso bor dran ting yin no/ /de gnyis bsgrub pa la gtso bor sems la gnad du bsnun nas stong gzugs rjes su dran pa sgrub pa por bsam/ gtso bor rlung la gnad du bsnun nas 'gyur med rjes mthun pa sgrub pa srog 'dzin te/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi gdul bya man chad la ming tsam yang ma bstan cing bla med gzhan la yang mtshan nyid tshang bar ma bstan pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi gdams pa'i mthar thug go /de lta bu'i thun mong min pa'i zab lam nyams su len pa la yang*/ thog mar dag snang phyogs med du 'byongs pa'i dad pa yod pas rang phyogs la chags dang*/ gzhan phyogs la sdang ba zhi ba/ legs bshad nyes bshad 'byed pa'i shes rab yod pas phyi dang*/ nang gi yang mdo sngags dang*/ de dag gi yang dngos bstan dman mchog la sogs pa'i dbye ba shes nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa spyir dgos kyi mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig nan tan gyis btsal la rten tshul la 'bad/ des bstan pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam rnams rdzogs pa'am/ ma mtha'ang go ba rnal ma chags shing myong ba sna zin gang skyes bya/ de nas/ rin chen gyis ni slus gyur na// rang sems rin chen rnam gnyis 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas byang sems lo paṇa la sogs pas rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang rim gro chen pos chos btsal ba ltar rang la yod pa'i sgo gsum lta ci smos/ longs spyod gang rnyed kyang 'bad pas bsgrubs te yul nas dbang dang gdam ngag gnad du bsnun pa zhu dgos kyi/ gzhan gyi zhor sgug pa'am/ rang la yon tan cung zad yod pa'i sdug yus kyis chos zhus kyang byin brlabs mi 'jug cing chos des bed cung zad kyang mi chod par myong ba dang mthong bas grub cing*/

yon tan gyi yus 'gro na/ rgyal sras rtag tu ngu lus gtsong pa'i rin gyis bla ma dang chos la mchod pa rtsom pa byed don med pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba gtso bor byas te/ ji skad bshad pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos skor la/ yun ring du 'bad par bya ste/ ston thog khyad par can don du gnyer bas thog mar zhing gi 'dul sbyong la 'bad pa rtsal ci yod kyis byed par mthong ba bzhin no/ /de nas gang du nyams su len pa'i gnas la sla chos mi bya ste/ chos lnga las/ bsod snyoms btsal sla ba ma yin na des g.yengs nas sdad long tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ gzhan bzang po min par chu ngan na lus la nad 'jug sa bzang po min par gzhi bdag ngan na sems la gdon 'jug grogs ngan na 'gal rkyen byed/ so mi bsod na sgom gnad du mi 'gro zhing rgyu mtshan gzhan 'khrid yig tu bris pa bzhin no/ /sgrub pa po ni/ mchog mi 'gyur du/ las dang po pa dbu ma sbyangs pa zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro// nyams su len tshul ni/ yid ches gsum ldan dgos te/ 'grel chen las/ sngags kyi theg pa 'di la yid ches pa rnam pa gsum bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ dang por re shig rgyud la yid ches pa dang*/ de nas bla ma la yid ches pa dang*/ de nas bdag nyid la yid ches pa ste/ yid ches pa 'di gsum gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ rnam pa gzhan du yid ches pa gsum med par lam gang bla mas slob ma la bstan pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu ster bar byed pa por mi 'gyur te/ slob ma'i dad pa dman pa nyid kyi phyir kun rdzob kyi bden pas 'jig rten pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro zhes don dam pa rdzogs rim gyi 'bras bur 'grub pa la yid ches gsum med mi rung du gsungs pas thog mar rgyud 'di'i che ba ston pa'i lung rigs la 'bad cing*/

de shes pa'i bla ma la gzhan las lhag pa'i mos gus dang*/ rang la yang zhum pa dang sgyid lug pa dor ste| rangs pa rgya cher skyed par bya'o/ /de yang 'grel chen du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rdo rje slob dpon rdzas la brkam pa dag 'byung par 'gyur te zhes sogs kyi skyon| rdzas la bsred pas phyug po snod min la 'das lam ster zhing rdo rje'i tshig 'byed pa'i chos 'tshong*/ skal ldan dbul po la mi ster bar yi chad du 'jug rdo rje'i tshig la rtsod pa smra zhing gzhung gzhan shes pa'i nga rgyal gyis rgyud 'grel byed/ bdud ris bla mar gyur nas rgyud don phyin ci log tu ston/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde bar bstan nas gsum po de nyid bzhi par 'chad/ glegs bam mthong ba tsam gyis dbang ma thob par rgyud ston pa ste/ de ltar rgyud ston pa ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi gdug pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis 'jug pa gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud gzhan dang dbang bzhi pa gsal por ma bstan zhing phyag rgya chen mo du ba la sogs pa'i lam sgom pa sbas zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyud nyid du yang rgyud kyi rgyal po thams cad las kyang nges par rdo rje'i tshig 'di rdo rje can gyis sbas pa ste/ sems can rnams kyis thar pa'i slad du dang po'i sangs rgyas su ni ma lus pa yang mngon sum gsungs zhes bzhi pa gzhan du sbas pa 'dir gsal gsungs pa dang*/ de phyir rgyud ni 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa mtha' dag ma tshang med pa rgyud kyi bla ma ste// dpal ldan rgyud ni dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po mngon par brjod pa zla ba bzang*/ /zhes 'jig rten pa bya spyod dang*/ 'das pa gong ma gnyis te/ bzhi ka'i brjod bya tshang bas bla ma dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis rigs so so ba lnga dang gsum la sogs pa las mi brjod la/ 'dis rgyal ba'i bdag po rigs drug pa gtso bor brjod pa dang*/

rgyud rnams ma lus gcig tu bsdus pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' lhag pa'i lha/ /thabs dang shes rab gcig sbyor rgyal ba'i bdag po'i rdo rje dag gi de nyid rnam pa bcu drug pa| |zhes rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' gtso bor byed cing thabs shes pha ma phyogs re ba ma yin par cha mnyam gcig tu sbyor ba dang*/ de nyid bco lnga tsam ston pa min par bcu drug dang*/ de bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo dang bden don bcu gnyis pa ste gang dang gang gi mthar thug de dang de bstan bya'i gtso bor byed pa dang*/ phyi rol du ni gang zag gi chu tshod brgyad pa'i phyed gyur sgra gcan longs spyod dag las gzhan du gnas/ de ni nang du rang gi lus la dbugs phyed nges par mun pa dag dang rnam par bral ba ste/ /snga ma phyed ni mun pa dang bcas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag stong pa gang du thim pa'o/ /de phyir de ni phug nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor ldan pa gcig tu mun pa bral bar 'jug |ces pa/ phyi rol du gza' lngas lo gsum phyogs gsum la longs spyad pa'i lhag ma zla ba gcig la dum bu brgyad du byas pa'i phyed dang brgyad sgra gcan gyi longs spyod brgyad pa'i phyed po mjug rings kyi longs spyod du gnas pa'i nges don nang du dhū ti'i snying kha man chod na snang ba'i rlung dang*/ snga ma sgra gcan gyi phyed po snying kha yan chod na mun pa'i rlung ste gzhi dus na 'pho med dbyug pa bzhin du gnas pa sdom chen gyi gtso bo yab yum gyi sgrub gzhir gsungs pa'i nang nas/ mun pa de phug nas snang ba'i rlung de mngon du 'gyur bar byed nus pa'i rnal 'byor ni dus kyi 'khor lo las gzhan pa med do zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid che brjod kyi gtso bor snang na yang spyan ras gzigs kyis gsal po rang gcig ma bkral ba'i rkyen gyis rgya bod sus kyang ma rnyed pa snang ngo*/

/lam gang nyams su blang ba la/ yan lag drug ka'ang sngon 'gro ltos med drug ldan/ dgos pa'i shes byed ni/ sgrub ler/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyi bsnyen pa ste/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/ nang du bdud rtsi lnga ni phung po lnga'o/ /sgron ma lnga ni dbang po lnga'o/ /de rnams la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen pa ste lus dang rdzas la bsred pa yongs su spangs pa'o// bsnyen pa de yis lha rnams mchog ster bar 'gyur te bshang ba/ lag pa zos pas ni ma yin no/ /chu gter rdo rje rnams dang zhes pa ni lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang sems kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang 'pho ba'i bde ba la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen pa ste/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang tshangs par spyod pa'i sdoms pa'o zhes pa'i don te/ 'di yis lha mchog ster bar 'gyur te/ srid pa'i longs spyod la zhen pas ni ma yin no/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du sngags kyi bzlas pa yang drang don bskyed rim pa'i ngag bzlas kyang sngon du 'gro dgos mod| de tsam gyis mi chog par nges don 'dzin pa la sogs par thams cad kyi sngon 'gro'am bsnyen par ni srog rtsol dgos te/ 'grel pa de'i 'phro las/ 'dir sngags kyi bzlas pa zhes pa ni/ srog sdoms pa ste/ sogs pa'i sgras dbyung ba dang dgang ba dang bum pa can gyi sbyor ba ni rtag tu bsnyen pa'o/ /de yis lha mchog ster bar 'gyur ba ste srog ma bsdams par ngag tu brjod pa ni ma yin no zhes so/ /rdor bzlas dang bum pa can sogs 'di dag kyang bsnyen par gsungs pa la brten nas/ bla ma dam pa sogs/ lus gnad dang rlung sbyor ci rigs pa rnams yan lag drug ka'i sngon 'gro yin gsung nas 'khrid gang yang ma phog pa'i sngon du zla re tsam 'di dag sbyong du 'jug pa dang*/ thun mtshams su rtsa rlung gi rnam gzhag rgyas par ston pa sogs mdzad mod kyi/

gang zag khyad par ba'i 'jug rim dang myong rtags dang bskyed rim la skye ba snga ma'i 'phro nas 'jug pa du ma srid kyang las dang po'i 'jug rim ni/ gsang 'dus pa dag 'dus pa phran nas slobs/ zhes thog mar bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad bstan nas myong rtogs ci rigs skyes pa'i rjes su ngo sprod kyi tshul du rgyud 'grel slob pa ltar| 'dir yang sa ris dang lag len bskyaid rdzogs kyi 'khrid rim sngon du gtang nas rgyud 'grel rdzogs par bshad/ de rjes 'chad pa po'i dbang bzhi rjes gnang dang bcas pa byin nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi go 'phangs la 'god pa rgyud 'grel las gsal bar gsungs pas 'khrid rim rang lugs ltar bya'o/ /dngos gzhi la/ yan lag drug gi mtshan ni/ 'dus pa phyi mar/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ /srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug du 'dod/ /ces dang*/ ma rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las kyang*/ so sor bsdud dang de bzhin du/ /bsam gtan srog rtsol 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces dang*/ bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud le'u dang por/ sngags bzlas de bzhin bsam gtan dang*/ /bde ba yis kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ rgyal sras phyag na rdo rjes/ kyang sgras bsam gtan gyi sor bsdud| sngags bzlas srog rtsol yin la/ des 'dzin pa/ bde ba ting nge 'dzin yin la/ des rjes dran shugs la ston pas/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug gis mchog 'grub kyi/ gzhan gyis mi 'grub pa dang*/ drug pa ting nge 'dzin cung zad mi gsal bar sbas kyang gzhan rnams shin tu gsal bar gsungs shing*/ pha rgyud 'dus par yang*/ yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsnyen pa byas na mchog 'grub ste/ /gzhan du sgrub bya dngos grub mchog /'byung bar 'gyur ba med pa nyid| |brtag gnyis su/

yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /dga' bral mthar yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang*/ gur du/ yan lag drug bsgom de nas ni// slar yang rang byin rlabs pa ste/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyi ma'i dngos bstan bskyed rim la dngos su sbyar nas slar yang rdzogs rim yan lag drug bsgom pa rnams/ drug gi grangs des ni sbyang bya phung po drug khams drug dbang po drug yul drug las dbang drug bya ba drug rnams kyang*/ ye shes nam mkha'/ rlung/ me/ chu/ sa drug tu 'dus zhing*/ de rnams sbyong byed rgyal ba rigs drug gi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sgrub ler/ so sor bsdud pa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur zhing bsam gtan mi skyod pa nyid do/ /srog rtsol dag kyang phyag na ral gri can no// slar yang rnam bcu 'dzin pa phyag na rin chen no/ /gdol pa mo la rjes su dran pa pad+ma 'dzin par gyur te dpal ldan ting 'dzin 'khor lo can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang*/ bsnyen sgrub bzhir bsdu ba ni/ bsnyen pa la ni dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam bcu mkha' la 'khor lo can gyi khro bos so/ /bgegs mthar byed pa'i lta ba bdud rtsi'i lam du son pa yis kyang nye ba'i sgrub pa yan lag drug/ shes rab la spros zla ba thig le rdo rje nor bu gnas pa'i 'gyur med gsum ni bsgrub pa la/ /bde ba ma nyams gcig pu zhi ba'i lhan skyes ye shes rnal 'byor 'dir ni sgrub pa chen po la/ /zhes sor bsam bsnyen pa/ srog 'dzin nyer sgrub/ rjes dran sgrub pa/ ting nge 'dzin sgrub ched du gsal bar gsungs shing*/ nges tshig ni/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs khad nye bas dang*/ de bzhin du sgrub pas dang*/ de bas kyang lhag par dang*/ shin tu lhag par sgrub pas so/ /de yang sbyang gzhi la/ mnga' gyi gnas skabs lus rdzogs pa dang*/ btsas pa'i gnas skabs de ma thag pa rlung gi rang bzhin ngag rdzogs pa dang*/ lo bco lnga'i bar sems rdzogs pa dang*/

bcu drug pa bde ba rdzogs pa ste bzhi'am/ bsdu na dang po gsum mas rim gyis sbyar ba sad rmi gnyid gti mug gi gnas skabs/ bzhi pa'i tshe bzhi pa ste gnas skabs bzhi yi sgrib pa sbyang ba'i phyir du/ smin byed bskyed rim la dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog dang yas babs thig le'i rnal 'byor dang*/ mas brtan phra mo'i rnal 'byor ste bzhi la bsnyen bsgrub bzhi gsungs pa rnams nyams su blangs pas legs par smin pa bzhin du rdzogs rim la yang de dag gi 'bras bu grol lam bsnyen bsgrub bzhi'o/ /de bzhin du bskyed rim bzhi po de la rdo rje bzhi'am zhal bzhi par gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang gsungs te/ ye ler/ dbu mar srog ni nyi ma dang bcas ri bong can gyi bgrod pa g.yas dang g.yon la bcing*/ /phyag rgya 'grogs la rab tu sems dang mchog gi bde ba la gnas rdo rje yang dag blang ba mang*/ /pad+mar rdo rje'i sgra'i rang gi lag pa'i chu skyes dag gis bsor ba bde ba'i slad du ste/ /sa bon gtong ba min pa'i bde ba 'di ni 'chi ba'i 'jigs 'phrog 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal| |zhes pa'i rkang pa dang pos sor bsam dang srog 'dzin la sku dang gsung gi gnyis pas rjes dran dang tha ma gnyis kyis ting nge 'dzin la thugs dang ye shes kyi zhal dang rdo rje 'grel chen du gsal bar gsungs so/ /de yang brtul zhugs gsum ste/ don dam bsnyen par/ rdo rje brlang ba 'di ni dang por gsungs pa ste/ rdo rje'i me la srog zhugs pa'i gnyis pa'o/ /dpal ldan byang chub sems ni mi ltung gsum pa'o/ /'di dag nyid ni dge ba'i brtul zhugs gsum nyid do/ /zhes/ sor bsam gnyis/ srog 'dzin gnyis/ dran ting gnyis rnams la thog mtha' bar gsum du dge bar gsungs so/ /de yang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi rnal 'byor gnyis su bstan te/ dbang mdor bstan du/ stong nyid gzugs brnyan 'dzin pa rgyu/

/snying rje 'gyur med 'dzin pa 'bras/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po lnga rgyu'i rnal 'byor dang*/ tha ma 'bras bu'i rnal 'byor ram/ rjes dran 'bras bur bsdus nas dang po bzhi la rgyu'i rnal 'byor du byas pa'ang yod cing*/ skye 'phags kyi rnal 'byor gnyis su bsdu na/ dang po lnga so skye'i lam du kun mthun la| tha ma la mkhas pa yer mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen stong brgyad brgya pa phrag dang po sbyor du bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ /'di dag gis 'pho chags sam bem chos kyi sa bon spong bar bzhed bzhin du rang lam gyi so skye'i sa na spang bya'i sa bon spong ba'i gnyen po med par mdo sngags kun mthun pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig ting nge 'dzin 'bras bu yin pas sangs rgyas kyi sar skyel ba yang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bskyed dgos pa la bsam nas zer na 'thad de/ kun tu 'od dang por byas pa'i sa bcu gnyis po 'di stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i zla la bgrangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sar spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pas so/ /rang lam gyi sangs rgyas la zer na shin tu mi 'thad de/ rang lam gyi spang bya spong bzhin pa'i sangs rgyas ni sus kyang mi 'jog pa'i phyir ro// phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 'di skyed cing spang bya spong dgos pa mi 'thad de| mun pa ma lus pa ma sangs na sangs rgyas su mi rung ba gang zhig sangs rgyas yin pas mun pa ma lus par sangs pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'o na nyan rang dgra bcom gyis slar yang spang bya spong mi dgos par 'gyur te/ /dgra ma lus par ma bcom na dgra bcom du mi rung ba gang zhig dgra bcom yin pas zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ma grub ste/ rang lam gyi spang bya'i dgra bcom pa tsam yang dgra bcom du rung ngo zhe na/ 'dir yang de bzhin no/ des na sngags lam du 'jug pa po'i ya mtha' sa bcu'i byang sems nyid dang*/ 'jug bya sngags lam gyi ya mtha' 'phags lam gyis chog gi

so skye'i lam gang yang bsnon mi dgos pa srid par bzhed pa la ni/ phar phyin theg pa'i sgom lam dang po brgyad kyis kyang ngau skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon spong mi nus par thal ba dang*/ mthong lam yin na rang gi sbyor lam sngon du song bas ma khyab par thal ba dang*/ kun tu 'od dang por byas pa'i sa bcu gnyis kyi rnam bzhag mi 'thad par thal ba dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i kun rdzob sems bskyed log shes su thal bas gnod pa'i phyir/ rang lam gyi sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs kyang theg pa gzhan gyis spang bya phra mo thugs la bzhag pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhig kyang srid do zhes bya ba 'di ni sngon chad gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma byung yang rigs pas grub cing*/ lung yang*/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi lung las/ bla mar bcas pa'i sangs rgyas dang*| |bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces sogs dang*/ gnas skabs kyi theg pa gsum dang*/ mthar thug gi theg pa gcig dang*/ gnas skabs kyi myang 'das dang*/ dgra bcom pas/ mthar thug gi de gnyis kyi/ go mi chod kyang*/ spyir myang 'das dang dgra bcom gyi go chod par gsungs pa'i gzhung lugs thams cad do/ /de ni zhar las byung ba'o/ /slar yang dkyus ma ni/ de ltar yan lag drug po tshang la rdzogs pa dgos kyi gang rung ma tshang bas mthar thug gi sangs rgyas mi 'grub ste/ sku rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dang*/ thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i zur nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /go rim nges pa ni/ yan lag drug po gang rung nas thog ma brtsam du mi rung ste/ nang ler| stong pa la ni du ba sogs bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gis gzugs brnyan mtshams su bsgom par bya/ /de nas rtsa ba'i 'khor lo rnams su srog dang thur sel rlung ni brtan pa dag kyang byed pa ste/ /de nas zla ba nges par 'gog pa gza' bzhin byed de byang chub sems ni rnal 'byor pa yis so/

/de nas gang zhig cung zad 'dod pa dag kyang nyin zhag 'ga' yis skye ba 'di la'o/ /zhes snga ma rdzogs rjes de nas de nas shes re re bzhin gsungs pa ltar 'grel chen gyis kyang gsungs la/ ye ler yang*/ du ba la sogs sgrub pa byas nas 'chi ba 'jig par byed pa'i dbu ma dag kyang bsgrub par bya/ /srog la sogs pa sgrub pa byas nas ri bong 'dzin pa zhu ba'i thig le dag kyang sgrub par bya/ /dam pa'i bde ba bsgrubs nas lhan cig skyes pa rgyal ba'i sku ni kun tu 'gro ba bsgrub par bya// zhes pas kyang go rim dang so so'i byed las bstan zhing*/ thun mong gi byed las ni| de ka'i 'jug tu/ sems can rnams la 'chi ster gang de grub pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mtha' dag bdud rtsi'i ste/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gang zhig bgrod bya min pa dag kyang srid gsum gnas su bsam gtan bgrod bya'o/ /ye shes gang zhig brnyed dka' dag kyang rdo rje pad+mar bde bas byin brlabs brnyed par sla ba nyid/ /de ltar de ltar rdo rje can de srog chags rnams la thams cad dus su bde mnyam ster gyur cig ces gsungs pa ste/ rdo rje can ni| gzhi'i dus 'khor la gtso bor dgongs la/ lam dang 'bras bu'i yang ngo*// de ltar na/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgya bod na gsung ngag rin po che zhes grags pa ltar/ rgyud sde mang po nas gsungs pa'i rdzogs rim sna bsdus pa yang ma yin te/ dus 'khor nyid nas dkyus gcig la gsungs pa ltar bla med gzhan du yang de bzhin du gsungs pa'i phyir/ nā ro dang ni gu'i chos drug tu grags pa ltar go rim nges med kyang min te/ snga ma snga ma sngon du ma song bar phyi ma phyi ma'i rtogs pa mthar thug skye mi srid pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du shes rab can du byas pas blos sgrigs pa'i rang bzo dang*/ phugs kyi khungs med pa'i rmi lam ma dang gter ma la sogs pa ma yin pa lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pas mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'dus pa dang thod rgal gang dran gyi mi chog pa'i rim pa nges pa dang ldan pa/

rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug thams cad kyis gces spras su mdzad pa/ skal ba mchog dang ldan zhing dbang po shin tu rno bas legs par zhugs na mi'i skye ba 'di nyid la mthar thug gi sangs rgyas bde blag tu bstsol bar mdzad pa'i lam gyi rgyal po'o zhes ngag tu yang yang 'don zhing yid la mos pa bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar drug po re re la yang rnam bzhag drug drug bya bar dpal dus 'khor zhabs pas gsungs pa ltar rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs par mkhas pa shong dang*/ bu dang*/ bla ma dam pa sogs kyis mdzad pa shin tu legs pa las/ kha cig bskyangs tshul dang*/ dbye ba la sogs pa'i rnam bzhag brgyad la sogs par byed pa dang*/ dmigs rim rkyang pa la gril nas rnam bzhag gang yang med par ston pa la sogs pa ni ha cang spros bsdus kyi dbang gis lhag pa dang chad pa'i skyon zhugs pas/ rnam gzhag drug ldan ni lung rigs dang ldan no/ /de yang mtshan don drug po lhan cig tu bshad pa ni/ sor bsdud kyi skad dod ni/ sra dha hā ra/ de'i pra ti ni nyer bsgyur te/ tsan+t+ra go mis nyer bsgyur nyi shu po re re yang don bcu bzhi tsam la 'jug pa las ma bshad kyang 'grel pa mkhan po gzhan gyis tshig grogs kyis dbang gis don nyi shu sogs la 'jug par bshad pa las 'dir phyir zlog pa'am spong ba/ yang na so so'am yang yang*/ ā hā ra ni zas dang 'phrog pa dang*/ bsdud pa la 'jug ste/ 'di ltar/ hṛnya 'phrog pa la'o/ āng sngon du da rjes 'brel/ nya yig ni/ in dang nya dang ya tsa sogs las gnyis ka'o zhes pas rjes 'brel/ dngos po la gha nya zhes pas gha ny rkyen du byin/ ny dbyangs bcas dang gha rjes 'brel lam/ ghanya'i nus pas ṛ yig 'phel bar gyur pas ā hā ra de sgra pa la grags pa'i ming ngam rtags yin te byings dang rnam dbye bor ba'i don dang ldan pa rtags so zhes so/

/de las pha rol rnams rnam dbye'o zhes/ de tshig tu sgrub pa la rnam dbye ster dgos shing*/ de yang dang po ngo bo/ gnyis pa bya ba/ gsum pa byed pa/ bzhi pa dgos ched/ lnga pa 'byung khungs/ drug pa 'brel pa/ bdun pa gnas gzhi brjod pa ste re re la yang gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig ste gsum gsum las 'di rnams la dang po'i gcig tshig ste/ rtags kyi don gyi tshig la rnam dbye dang po zhes pas/ si byin/ i rjes 'brel dang sa rnam dpyad du bya ba ni phal cher la thob cing*/ nyer bsgyur rnams kyang de bzhin du tshig tu bsgrubs/ mthar tshig gcig tu bsdud pa'i tshe/ der gnas rnam dbye rnams dbyi bar bya'o zhes pas phyis/ rtags gcig tu song ba'i mthar slar yang si byin pas/ pra t+yā hā rāḥzhes pa/ byings don dang por brjod na/ zas sam 'phrog pa spong bas zas spong zhes par 'gyur te/ 'khor ba pa'i zas ni dbang po yul la 'jug pas dge ba 'grog pa yin la/ de rnal 'byor 'dis spong bas so/ /'di ni spang bya'i sgo nas btags te yongs su ma grags pa'i don la thob pa'i mtshan no/ /nyer sgrub dang por brjod na dbang yul so so'am nyi tshe ba yang yang 'byung ba'i rnam g.yeng*/ sha'i mig gis rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong gzugs gcig tu bsdud pa'i sor sdud ces pa gnyen po'i sgo nas btags pa yongs su grags pa'i mtshan no/ /de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi skad dod dh+yā naḥ ces pa'ang*/ dh+yai sems dpa' la'o/ dngos po las ma ning la k+ta'o/ yuṭa'o/ ṭa yig ṣ+ta rjes su 'brel ba las ni ī'o/ /zhes pas rjes 'brel/ yu bu dzha rnams kyi a na laka an+ta dag go zhes pas yu a nar sgyur/ byings mtha'i ai ni/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i mtha' rnams kyi bi ka ra ṇa ma yin pa la ā yig go zhes bsgyur nas/ rkyen gyi a na'i.a rang sbyar bas dh+yā na la yang si byin pa ste/ mdor na sems par byed do zhes pa saṃskṛ ta'i sgra la byung ba de 'khrid yig gi mtshan don dang sbyar ro/

/de bzhin du srog stsol gyi skad dod pra ṇā yā maḥzhes pa yang*/ shwa sa srog la'o/ a na yang ngo*/ zhes pa'i byings phyi ma la/ pra sngon du bzhag pa tsa sogs rnams las a tsa'ang ngo zhes pas a tsa rkyen du byin/ tsa dbyangs don yin pas phyis/ pra'i a dang byings kyi a mtshungs 'dra byas pas prā ṇa/ ṇar song ba ni/ ra ṣa ri'i yi ge rnams las mtha' ma yin pa'i na'i ṇa ste zhes prā'i ra'i dbang gis so/ /ya mu 'gog pa la'ang*/ dngos po gha nya/ byings kyi sngon du āng*/ nga dang gha dang nya rnams rjes 'brel la/ nya rjes 'brel gyi dbang gis byings kyi a ring por song*/ rnam dbye ster ba dang bsdu ba byed tshul gong bzhin byas pas/ prā ṇā yā maḥ srog kun nas 'gog ces pa'o/ des na rtsol pa ni/ 'gog pa'i rtsol ba zhes pa rkyen gyi nus pa'am/ yang na 'gog pa dang*/ rtsol ba don gcig tu byas pa'o/ /sa 'dzin pa'i skad dod dhā ra ṇā ces pa dh+ṝny 'dzin pa la'o/ n+dhuṭa'i rkyen/ byings kyi nya dang rkyen gyi ṇa dang ṭa rnams rjes 'brel/ ṇa'i nus pas/ ṛ yig gi 'phel ba ār du song*/ rkyen gyi yu a nar bsgyur ba'o/ /de ltar 'dzin par byed do zhes so| |rjes dran gyi skad dod a nu smṛ tiḥ smṛ sems pa la'o/ k+ti rkyen/ a nu sngon| ka rjes 'brel/ ka da rjes 'brel gyi rkyen la yon tan med pas/ a nu smṛtiḥnyid de rjes su dran par byed do zhes pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi skad dod/ sa mā dhi/ dhi 'dzin pa la'o/ yang na ṭu dha nya 'dzin pa la'o/ /ḍunya rjes 'brel/ ḍi rkyen| ḍa rjes 'brel gyi nus pas byings mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa phyis nas i bcug byings kyi sngon du nyer bsgyur saṃ dang āng bzhag nas sngar bzhin bsgrubs pa ste/ sgra 'gyur yang dag par kun nas 'dzin zhes pa'o/ /dus mtshams drug ni/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ rim pa bzhin/ g.yas pa sa'i rlung du bsgom/ /zhes dang*/

dus ni nam mkha' rgyu dus so/ /zhes dang*/ 'du byed phung po rlung rgyu dus/ /zhes dang*/ nam mkha'i dus/ zhes dang*/ ye shes rlung ni rgyu dus so/ /zhes bshad pa'i/ sor bsdud kyi dus mtshams ni*/ 'grel chen las 'dir gang gi tshe khro bo'i lta stangs rnal 'byor pa stong pa la sems bkod pa'i rnal 'byor pa mig mi 'dzum par gyur pa de'i tshe g.yon nas g.yas su zhes pa ni nye bar mtshon pa ste/ gang gi tshe g.yas su sa rab tu 'bab pa'i dus su rnal 'byor pa bsgom par byed pa de'i tshe cho ga 'di'o/ /g.yon pa'i rtsa la rab tu 'bab pa'i dus su ni ma yin te/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa spro ba'i rim pas zhes rdzogs rim la sa chu la thim pa la sogs pa bsdud rim 'byung par 'grel par gsungs pa dang mthun zhing rig pas thob pas legs mod kyi gzhan rnams la rgyu mtshan ma mthong zhing*/ rwa pas sna bug g.yon pa'i rlung rnams zhi gzas bdag byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'jam pas thog mar de'i tshe bya'o zhes zer ba'ang 'grel tshig des bkag go /snyan rgyud las/ bsam gtan nam mkha'i rlung rgyu dus bsgoms par bshad pa de/ bsam gtan gyi ngo bo mi skyod pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin yin pa la dgongs pa 'dra gsung pa'ang ma yin te/ de lta na sor bsdud rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pa sogs gzhan la'ang sbyar dgos pa las nges pa mi snang bas so/ /des na rlung gi rgyu dus ni thams cad la g.yas kyi sa rlung rgyu dus nyid thog ma'i sgom dus yin par 'grel chen gyis tshig 'dis bstan pa'am/ yang na khro bo'i lta stangs kyi tshe zhes pa'i tshig la nus pa 'don na/ yan lag dang po gnyis la sa/ gnyis pa gnyis la me| gsum pa gnyis la nam mkha'i rlung rgyu dus bsgom par bzhed dam brtag par bya zhing*/ spyir yan lag snga ma snga ma rdzogs nas phyi ma phyi ma sgom dgos pa ni go rim nges pa'i rigs pa dang*/

rmi lam bzhin du gzugs mthong gyur/ /rtag tu gzugs de bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang*/ gzugs brnyan mthong na de nas ni// bar ma chad par srog rtsol bya/ /zhes dang*/ gzugs brnyan mthong na de nas nyin zhag so so'i rlung ni 'gog pa rab bya ste/ /zhes pa gnyis kyis srog rtsol gyi dus mtshams dang*/ /zla nyi'i bgrod pa bcom pa las/ /gzhan du thur sel yan lag la/ /srog gi rlung ni 'jug pa med/ /ces pa 'dzin pa'i dus mtshams kyi rjes dran bskyed dgos par gsungs pa gsal la/ ting nge 'dzin la yang*/ ye ler| de ni shes rab ye shes skad cig gal te thig le'i phreng ba g.yo ba med pas bde na'o/ /zhes pas rjes dran mthar thug bstan nas/ de phyir 'pho med bde ba'i skad cig lhan cig skyes pa 'di ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ster byed de/ / zhes pa'i de phyir ni gtan tshigs kyi tshig min gyi/ de'i phyir rjes de ma thag ces pa nyid shin tu gsal la/ go rim gyi skabs su drangs pa'i nang le'i/ stong pa la ni du ba sogs lam zhes sogs kyang shin tu gsal lo/ /mtshan nyid drug gi shes byed ni/ sgrub ler/ so sor bsdud pa lus la yul dang yul can bcu po rnams ni rab tu 'jug pa med pa ste/ /bsam gtan dag kyang shes rab rtog dang dpyod dang dga' dang g.yo med bde ba rtse gcig sems pa'o/ /srog rtsol dag kyang lam ni gnyis po sgyel nas dbu mar srog ni zhugs pa dag tu 'gyur// gang phyir gnyis ka'i bgrod pa bcom ste dbu mar thig le la ni rtse gcig sems pa 'dzin pa'o/ /gtum mo'i snang bar gang zhig gyur pa nges par lus dang nam mkha' la yang rjes su dran par 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid kyis ni 'gyur med bde ba'i dbang gi ye shes gzugs la ting nge 'dzin/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis mtshan nyid rgyas par bstan la/ phyag rdor stod 'grel du yang yan lag tha ma cung zad sbas pa'i tshul gyis bsdus nas gzhan rgyas par bstan cing rdo rje snying 'grel dang*/

dbang mdor bstan rtsa 'grel las/ shin tu gsal ba 'dir yi ge mang kyi dogs pas de dag la bslab par bya'o/ / gsang 'dus kyi rgyud phyi ma dang de'i dngos 'grel nā ro pa dang*/ sgron gsal gyi le'u bcu gnyis par drangs nas bkral ba dang*/ zhabs lugs pa'i 'grel pa rnams su bkral ba ni cung zad bshad tshul mi mthun pas de dag gi rdzogs rim du bshad par bya'o/ /dbye ba so so'i shes byed ni/ ngo bo'i dbye ba dang lhag pa'i lha'am rigs kyi gzhung ni/ so sor bsdud pa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur zhing rnam pa bcu ste bsam gtan mi skyod pa nyid do/ /srog rtsol dag kyang ral gri can no/ /slar yang rnam pa bcu ste 'dzin pa phyag na rin po che'o/ /gdol pa mo ni rjes su dran pa pad+ma 'dzin par 'gyur te dpal ldan ting 'dzin 'khor lo can| |zhes pa rtsa 'grel du re re yang bcu bcur gsungs la/ bsgom tshul gyi dbye ba ni sor bsdud la/ 'grel chen du sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la rnal 'byor goms pa rnam pa gnyis te/ nam mkha' dang bla gab med pa la rnal 'byor goms pa'o/ /zhes mtshan mo'i dus su mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor dang nyin mo'i dus su nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnal 'byor lta ba gang yin pa de ni mtshan mo nam mkha' la lta zhing nyin mo bla gab med pa la blta'o zhes dang*/ gzhi shes kyi mdo drangs pa bzhin phyag rdor gyis rgyas par drangs nas bsgrubs pa ltar rgyud nyid du/ nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang zhes dang*/ nam mkha' chu 'dzinabral ba dag la rnal 'byor pa yis bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste/ /zhes sogs lung dang*/ lo la bgrod pa gnyis/ zla ba la phyogs gnyis/ zhag la nyin mtshan gnyis la sogs pa'i rigs pas so/ /bsam gtan gyi yang 'di gnyis de dang 'dra la/ dgos su bsgom tshul yan lag lnga ste/ mtshan nyid theg pa'i bsam gtan dang po la/
mdzod du/ dang po la lnga rtog dpyod dang*/

dga' dang bde dang ting 'dzin rnams| |zhes pa bzhin mngon pa gong ma sogs su yang 'byung ba dang mthun pa la| ting 'dzin nam sems rtse gcig pa zhes pa gnas kyi yan lag tu bshad pa'i dod du shes rab ces pa ma gtogs mtshan nyid kyang rjes su dran par rgyud 'di dang gzhan du yang gsungs so/ /srog rtsol gyi dbye ba'i shes byed/ spyir phyag rdor dang nā ro pas dbyung ba dang dgang ba dang bum pa can gyi zhes gsum las ma gsungs kyang*/ sgrub ler/ zla ba nyi ma la ni ā sogs kā sogs rnam gsum bgrod gnas sku yi rdo rje sogs bzlas pa/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel du/ g.yon ā l̥ zla ba'i bgrod pa sku rdo rje/ g.yas kā li nyi ma'i bgrod pa gsung rdo rje| dbu ma ma ning sgra gcan gyi bgrod pa thugs rdo rje zhes gsal bar gsungs la| de gsum yig 'bru gsum dang sbyar na/ oṃ yig ni zla ba'i chos thig le can dang*/ āḥyig ni nyi ma'i chos tsheg drag can du nges shing*/ sgra gcan hūm̐ yig gi rang bzhin lan mang du gsungs pa dang*/ 'di gsum gyi sgra sgrub kyi skabs su yang rdo rje gsum du gsal bar gsungs pas/ ye le'i sdom chen gyi bzlas pa'i skabs las gzhan du rdor bzlas ma bshad do zhes bu ston gsung pa ni mi mod/ de ltar rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ 'grel chen du dbyung ba dang dgang ba dang gzhil ba dang bum pa can gyi sbyor bas zhes gsungs zhing*/ ro tsa ka dngos su ma gsungs kyang gzhil ba'i shugs la bstan cing*/ kyai rdor du/ 'byung ba nyid kyis ltung bar byed/ /rngub pa yis ni dbang du byed/ /dgang ba yis ni 'gugs par byed| |zhi ba yis ni rengs par byed/ /ces dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ su ri kas ni dgang bar bya/ /ro tsa kas ni dbugs mnan bya/ /bum pa can gyis bsdom par bya/ /bu ga'i sgo ni sbyang bar bya/ /rab tu zhi bas zhi bar bya/ /zhes pa'i zhi bas ni phyir gzhil ba bstan to/

/'dzin pa'i bsgom tshul drug gi bzhi ni/ stod 'grel du/ 'dzin pa ces pa ni lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dbang chen dang chu dang me dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la srog zhugs pa zhes par gsal bar bstan la/ gnyis ni/ der sna'i sgras lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba dang gtsug tor gyi pad+ma brjod de zhes dang*/ snyan brgyud du/ nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag drug ces dang*/ rgyud du yang*/ nye ba'i sgrub pa yan lag drug ces gsungs pa nyid do/ /dran ting la phyag rgya gsum gyis bsgrub dgos pa ni| rgyud kyi sngar bshad pa'i sbyor drug gi mtshan nyid bstan pa'i 'jug tu/ 'di dag sman pa la sogs dbye ba rnams kyis sna tshogs gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /phyag rgya gsum dang gnas skabs gsum ni rnam gsum bgrod pa'i dbang gis las dang kun rtog mchog rnams so/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel dang*| bzhi pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya yang dgos par/ ye ler/ rgyal ba'i lhan skyes bde ba 'di ni 'phel ba'i don slad dang por las kyi phyag rgya brten par bya| |phyi nas ye shes gzugs ni lus dang rkang pa gtsug tor yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ /glog gi dbyug pa'i rjes mthun 'pho med bde ba bskyed par byed ma mtshan nyid yan lag yongs su rdzogs/ /rdo rje rnams kyis rab tu snang bar byed ma srid gsum gnas lus chos kyi dbyings su de nas 'gyur| |'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba'i 'bras ster phyag rgya bzhi po 'di dag grong dang 'brog dgon dur khrod dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis gsungs so/ /bzhi kas 'gyur med ster bar gsungs pas ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su yang las ye gnyis sbyor ba rtsom pa'i dus su dgos med kyi mthar phyag chen nyid kyis sgrub par ni/ /snying ni rtog pa dang bcas las kyi phyag rgya 'di dang brtags pa'i ye shes phyag rgya btang byas te/

/yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub slad du rgyal ba mchog gi bskyed ma mchog gi phyag rgya dgos pa med/ /rnam pa 'gyur ba med cing mkha' mnyam mun bcom khyab byed rnal 'byor dag gi bgrod bya brtsegs mar gnas| |ye shes gzi brjid srid pa'i dri ma 'phrog byed dus kyi 'khor lo rjes su rim pas bsgom par bya/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /des na dbang brtul las rgya/ dbang 'bring ye rgya zhes sogs kyang gang zag rgyud gcig gi byang ma byang lta bu la dgongs kyis/ rgyud thad kyis khyab bar 'dod pa dag gis ni/ spyir dbang po yang rab rin po che lta bu'i gang zag la 'dzam bu gling pa'i mis khyab par gzhung gzhan du gsungs shing*/ khyad par 'dir mi'i rten la mtshang rgya bar rgya cher gsungs pa cung zad ma dgongs so/ /bsgom tshul drug la nges par drug ldan gyi gnas ni/ sor bsam la mtshan mo mun khang mtshan nyid tshang ba dgos pa dang*/ nyin mo sprin med dgos par ni/ mtshan mo bug pa med pa'i khyim du zhes dang*/ nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba zhes sogs kyis dngos su gsungs shing*| yan lag bar pa gnyis la gnas dngos su mi gsal bas snga ma gnyis dang rjes mthun/ tha ma gnyis ni/ grong dang 'brog dgon dur khrod dang*/ /mi gtsang ba dang gtsang ba'i gnas dang lha mchog khang pa dag gam chu bo 'dus pa rnams su te/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dug stangs ni/ spyir ting nge 'dzin dang mnyam bzhag bsgom pa la rnam snang gi chos bdun bsngags par rnam snang mngon byang sogs kyi mdo rgyud gzhan du gsungs shing*/ bsgom pa dang bstod pa'i dus su sangs rgyas pa la rdo rje'i gdan bsngags par gsungs pa sogs las lta stangs so sor gsungs pa chos gzhan drug ci rigs pa ste/ srog rtsol gyi skabs su bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng las/ sems dpa'i skyil krung legs gnas te/ zhes dang*/ sor bsdud la/ snyan rgyud du/ lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams par bya/

zhes bshad pas gang rung bya bar bstan to/ /lta stangs ni/ rgyud du/ bsnyen pa la ni dang po'i rnal 'byor rnam bcu mkha' la 'khor lo can gyi khro bo lta bas so/ /bgegs mthar byed pa'i lta ba bdud rtsi'i lam du son pa yis kyang nye ba'i bsgrub pa yan lag drug /zhes pas thog bar gnyis kyi lta stangs gsal bar gsungs kyang tha ma gnyis gsal bar ma gsungs mod/ 'dus pa phyi mar/ bsnyen pa'i dus na gtsug tor che'i/ /gzugs brnyan 'bad pas rnam bsgom bya| |nye bar bsgrub pa'i dus su ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzugs brnyan no// rnal 'byor brtson pas bsgrub pa la/ /lha yi gzugs brnyan bsgom bya ste/ /sgrub pa chen po'i dus su ni/ /sangs rgyas mnga' bdag gzugs brnyan no/ /zhes pa phyag rdor stod 'grel du drangs nas/ nges don du/ gtsug tor chen po nam mkha'i dbyings dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba rlung dang*/ lha stong gzugs dang*/ mnga' bdag 'gyur bsgom pa la sbyar yang*/ drang don/ gtsug tor gyi nam mkha' dang*/ bdud rtsi'i gnas smin mtshams dang*/ lha byang chub sems dpa'i gzigs stangs dang*/ mnga' bdag rnam snang lta bu'i gzigs stangs rnams bsnyen sogs bzhi la bya bar gsungs pa shin tu gsal bas rlung sbyor bum pa can gyi dus su lte ba'i rlung dang rdor bzlas kyi dus su sna sgo'i rlung la lta bar bzhed pa dang*/ 'dug stangs la'ang*/ g.yon gyi rlung sbyor gyi dus su g.yon rkyang byed pa lta bu lta stangs stabs kyi dag pa dang bstun par byed pa sogs ni 'thad par ma mthong ngo*/ /byed bcings ni/ 'jam dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba las/ mtshan mo gseng med khyim du ni/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag sgrub pa pos/ /byed pa lnga la bcing pa gnyis/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ phyag rdor gyis kyang*/ byed pa bcing ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /sa gsum po ni bsgrub par bya/

/zhes pa byed pa mig la sogs pa rnams kyis sa gsum du sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan bsgrub bar bya ste| de yi nye bar bstan pa ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o/ /zhes rgyud 'di dang*| byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel bshad zhal shes la rag ma las pa'i che brjod yang yang mdzad nas 'dir de ltar gsungs pa ni/ byed pa dbang po lngas yul 'dzin pa yin la de srog thur gyi rlung gnyis bcings pas 'ching dgos shing de lus gnad dang lta stangs gnad du song ba la ltos la/ de bla mas gnang ba gsal bar khrid de legs par slob pa la dgongs so/ /sems kyi 'jog tshul la drug gi sor bsdud sogs drug la/ gang la 'jog pa'i yul ni rim pa bzhin/ nam mkha'i dbyings dang*/ phyi'i stong gzugs dang*/ rlung dang thig le dang*/ nang gi stong gzugs dang*/ bde chen dang de dbyer med rnams yin la/ gang du 'jog pa'i gnas la rang lugs ni/ smin mtshams nas gnas bcu drug pa'i nam mkha' dang*/ phyi'i stong gzugs gang du grub pa dang*/ sna sgo'am lte ba'i rlung gi gnas dang*/ 'khor lo drug gi dbus dang*/ lte bar nang gi stong gzugs mthong ba dang*/ dhū tī'i nang rnams rim pa bzhin yin par lung rigs kyis 'grub bo/ /gzhan lugs dgag pa ni/ mkhas pa dag sor bsdud kyi bsgom pa dhū tī'i yas sna mdzod spu'i nang gi sna bug gnyis 'dus pa na yod pa der bsgom dgos te/ spyir lus la gnad du ma bsnun na rdzogs rim du mi 'gro zhing de yang dhū tīr bsnun pa nges par dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ lung yang*/ nam mkhar kun zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzums rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yis// zhes pa'i 'grel par/ rdo rje'i lam a ba dhū tī'i lam la zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de lta ma yin par nam mkha' stong par sems bzhag pa ni phyi rol pa dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i bsgom du 'gyur zhes rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rgya cher sgrogs par mdzad do/

/de lta na lta stangs mthon po yang don med du 'gyur zhing*/ mkhas pa nā ro pas/ bar snang la ni yid dang rlung dang mig dus gcig tu ni gal te legs sbyar na/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan rin chen nges par skye/ /'di rnams mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungs/ /zhes dang*/ sna tshogs rnam rtog bral zhing mi sems par/ /gal te bar snang la ni mi gtad na/ /phyogs mtshams bcu yi 'jig rten yin nam snyam/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mtha' dag 'di las thob// ces dang*/ de bzhin du sa ra ha dang shwa ba ri sogs kyis kyang mig bar snang la gtod pa dang der yid dang rlung kyang gnas dgos par gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal zhing*/ gtso bor rdzogs rim la rtsa 'khor dbus su dmigs pa dgos par ma nges te/ gsang 'dus 'phags pa'i lugs kyi lus dben rjes thob rigs brgya'am rigs lnga'i rnal 'byor dang*/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal du sdud pa'i ril 'dzin rjes bzhig gi rnal 'byor dang*/ man ngag khyad par can bsre ba skor gsum la sogs pa thams cad la rtsa 'khor dang dhū tīr dmigs pa sogs med pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi lam gshin rje gshed kyi shin tu spros med la sogs pa rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du bsnun pa dngos su med pa du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du ji ltar 'jog tshul yang*/ phyag rdor gyis sor bsdud kyi skabs su stong nyid la dmigs pas zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ spyir yang stong nyid kyi lta ba skyong ba la bdag med med dgag gi 'dzin stangs gsal zhing nges par shugs drag pa'i rgyun bskyang dgos pas ngag tu bdag med zhes yang yang brjod pa dang blos kyang de ltar 'dzin pa'i dran shes kyi rtog pa shin tu gsal ba dgos so zhes kha cig zer la/ gzhan dag de 'dra'i rigs shes bsam byung gis 'tshol ba tsam yang mi dgos kyi rtog pa bkag pa nyid kyi sgo nas cir yang mi bsam pa kho na mchog yin no zhes lung rigs du ma dang bcas nas smra bar byed do/

/lung ni lugs snga ma la so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis bdag 'dzin nam bden 'dzin yang dgos kyi de med par yid la mi byed pa tsam gyis grol na ha cang thal ba dang*/ 'dzin stangs can gyi spang bya la rang dang rnam pa 'gal ba'i gnyen po dgos par mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas gsungs shing rigs pa yang 'jig lta dang bden 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pa la thug la/ lugs phyi ma la yang rtog pa dang mtshan ma dang spros pa la skyon du gsungs pa shin tu mang zhing mthar rtog pa 'gog pa'i lam zhig mi dgos na sangs rgyas kyi sar yang rtog pa yod par*/ la ba dang*/ mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa la mi rtog pa rjes mthun tsam gyi nyer len yang med par 'gyur ba dang*/ ji srid yid kyi rnam g.yo ba/ /de srid bdud kyi spyod yul te/ /zhes dang*/ gang dag rnam par dben snyam du/ /g.yo ba'i yid kyang mi g.yo de/ /nyon mongs sbrul gyis bkrugs gyur pa'i| |ltar gyur srid pa'i rgya mtsho rgal/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa sogs kyi lung rigs phyogs gnyis ka la shin tu mang bas/ kho bo ni phyogs gcig rgyu mtshan du byas nas gang rung gcig la dgrar bltas byas na rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa phyed phyed 'dor dgos par mthong nas 'di ltar smra ste/ spyir gyi gsung rab mtha' dag gi bstan don bsdu na/ ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ cung zad dpyad pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ legs par dpyad pa'i rnam gzhag gsum yod la/ de 'jal bar byed pa'i blo la yang thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab gsum yod pas rnam gsum po shes rab gsum gyis rim bzhin 'jal ba na/ rnam gzhag dang po la 'khor 'das blang dor thams cad shes mtshungs kyi tshul du kun rdzob bden pa gtso bor gton pa ni thos byung gis dang*| gnyis pa la tha snyad pa dang don dam pa'i gnas lugs bden stong dang bdag med tsam zhig rigs shes kyi ngor 'grub kyi gzhan rnams nges ngor nub pas na don dam bden pa gtso bor ston pa rnams ni bsam byung gis dang*/

gsum pa la stong nyid de yang shes brjod kyi yul las 'das par brjod pas spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhi bar gsungs pa thams cad sgom byung gi yul du byed dgos pa'i phyir na/ thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs mi dgos pa dang*/ dgos kyang rigs shes rjes dpag la sogs pa rtog pa tshad ma'i lam mi dgos par 'dod na thos bsam la skur pa gtab cing rnam gzhag dang po gnyis ston pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la rgyab kyis phyogs par 'gyur zhing*/ zhi gnas la skyon zhing dbyer med du byas nas bsgom pa'i tshe yang*/ rjes dpag gi bsam byung las ma 'das par 'dod na/ legs par dpyad pa'i rnam gzhag ston pa nges don gyi mdo sngags mtha' yas pa spangs shing sgom byung khyad par can gyi go ba ma chags par 'gyur te/ zhi gnas kyi dmigs rten chos can kun rdzob pa rags pa ma yin par/ shin tu phra ba'i dbyings la spros pa mtha' dag zhi ba'i tshul gyis rtse gcig tu bzhag pa ni zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sgom byung yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ /sor bsdud kyi sems 'jog tshul dang po'i lugs ni/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /nyi ma gcig ni yongs su brtag /ces pa'i rgyud dang*/ yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /ces sogs du ma dang*/ 'grel chen du/ /stong nyid byang chub ni/ dang por mun pa la cung zad kyang bsam par mi bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar sems 'grel gzhan gnyis su yang gsung shing*/ sa ra has bsam dang bsam bya yongs su dor nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung tshul du gnas bya zhing*/ /bla ma'i lung la sgrims te gus 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces dang*/ mig mi 'dzum par blta dang mi bsam dang*| |rlung 'gag pa ni dpal ldan bla mas rtogs/ /zhes dang*/ sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar rtogs byas te/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin nyid du sems nyid gzung*| |yid de yid ma yin par byed gyur na/ /des ni bla med byang chub rtogs par 'gyur/

/zhes dang*/ rmongs pa nam mkha'i tshad ma ni/ /gal te shes na rmongs tshogs gcod/ /dang por rnam dag nam mkha' la/ /bltas shing bltas shing mthong ba 'gag /ces dang*/ yid bkag pa rmongs par 'dod pa dgag pa'i phyir du/ /rtog pa nyams pas blo nyams zhes/ /blo ngan rjes su rtog byed lo// 'di nyid las ni blo bzang po/ /nam mkha' las lhag ci yang 'byung*/ /zhes dang*| yid kyi rtsa ba dbyung byas te/ /stong pa nyid la goms byed pa/ ma rig rab rib gyis stong la/ /mig sman 'di las gzhan ci yod/ /ces sogs dang*/ bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /ces sogs mdo phyogs na shin tu mang ngo*// 'jog tshul gnyis pa ni/ yang dag nyid la yang dag lta zhes dang*/ /mdo sde rgyan las| rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs byas nas/ /de la slar yang bslan par bya// zhes sogs dang*/ 'dir/ stong par rtse gcig yid bya ste/ /zhes sogs so// gsum pa ni/ mdor/ 'das la rjes su 'gro mi byed/ /ma 'ongs pa la lta mi bya// zhes sogs dang*/ nā ro pas/ dang por thog mtha' las grol ba'i/ /dbu ma tsam la yang dag gnas/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ sa ra has/ bcings na phyogs bcur brgyugs nas 'gro// bkrol na g.yo ba med pa bzhin/ /mdza' mo bdag gis rnga mo mthong*/ /bdag la phyin ci log par snang*/ /zhes dang*/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di| |glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /bram ze bskud pa 'khal ba bzhin// rnal 'byor shes pa glod na bde/ /zhes pa'o/ /nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi shes byed ni| nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag la rnal 'byor pa yis bgrad pa'i mig gis blta byas te/ /re kha nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar gyur gyi bar du'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'jam dpal grags pas kyang*/ chu 'dzin dang ni bral ba yi/ /nam mkha' dwangs par gyur pa na/ /snga dro nyin mar rgyab phyogs te/ /phyi dro yang ni de bzhin no/ /nyin phyed mig la gnod phyir spang*//

zhes sogs so/ /myong rtags ni/ 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi mar/ 'gog pa rdo rje bgrod sems la/ /mtshan ma nyer 'dzin 'byung 'gyur te/ /mtshan ma de ni rnam pa lngar// byang chub rdo rjes bshad pa yin/ /dang po'i smig sgyu'i rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba'i rnam pa can/ /gsum pa mkha' snang rnam pa ste/ /bzhi pa sgron me 'bar ba'o/ lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes dang*/ gur las// yan lag drug sgom rnal 'byor pas/ /slar yang rang byin brlabs pa ste/ /rjes dran cho ga'i rim pa yis/ /phyi nang mtshan ma mtshan par bya/ dang por sprin dang 'dra ba ste/ /gnyis pa du ba 'dra ba yin/ /gsum pa me khyer rnam pa yin/ /bzhi pa mar me cher 'bar ba/ /lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni/ /sprin med nam mkha' 'dra ba nyid| |ces dang*/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ phyir log pa ni log pa yis// smin sgyu lta bur snang ba ni/ /mtshan ma dang por shes par bya/ /de bzhin du ni chu log pas/ /du ba lta bu gnyis pa yin/ /de bzhin me ni rnam log pas/ /mkha' snang 'dra ba gsum pa'o/ /de bzhin rlung ni log pa na/ /mar me lta bur rab snang ba| |rtags ni bzhi par shes par bya/ /de bzhin phyin log rnam par shes// log pas zab gsal gnyis med kyi/ /don 'dra sprin med nam mkha' ltar// gsal ba rtags ni lnga pa'o/ /mtshan ma lnga po 'di yis ni/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces dang*/ de kho na nyid grub pa las/ dang po ri dwags sred bzhin snang ba ste/ /mtshan ma gnyis pa dud pa'i rnam pa can/ /mi thub zla bas/ gur dang 'dra bar/ dang por sprin dang 'dra ba ste/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ gsang 'dus skor du smig rgyu dang*/ kyai rdor skor du/ sprin dang por gsungs kyang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel du/ 'dir bla ma'i nye bar bstan pas rnal 'byor pas nam mkha' la dang por du ba mthong ste/ smig sgyu ni ma yin no zhes rang gis nyams su myong bas shes par bya'o/
