/zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan du bshad pa de bla ma'i nye bar bstan pas go log nas bshad dgos pa'i sbas don du gsungs pa ltar/ dbang mdor bstan du/ du ba smin sgyu mkha' snang dang*/ /sgron me 'bar ba zla nyi ma| |mun can cha dang thig le che/ /shes rab gzugs brnyan 'od gsal ba// zhes dang*/ ye ler/ stong pa la ni du ba smig sgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang*/ /'bar ba dang ni zla ba'i nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur/ /de'i nang du sangs rgyas gzugs dang yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes pa'i dang po bzh-i gsang 'dus su bshad pa mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi rtags dang phyi ma drug nyin rtags mtshan brjod du bshad par 'grel chen gnyis su gsal bar gsungs shing*/ longs sku mthong ba ni gtso bor bsam gtan gyi myong rtags so| |sor bsdud sogs sems gnas khyad par can bsgoms pa na/ sems nyams| dang por rnam rtog mang du song ba snyam byed cing rgyu ba drag la gsal ba dang*| de nas rgyu 'phro la ma tshor bar zhi ba dang*/ de nas mnyam gzhag gsal dwangs kyi 'phro la rnam rtog thol thol skye ba dang*/ de nas skyes kyang nyis 'thud gsum 'thud tsam gyi ngang nas de nyid du zhi ba dang*/ rkyen gzhan gyis ma sad na mnyam gzhag tu 'byams 'gro ba rnams 'byung ba la/ bla ma snga ma rnams sgom nyams chu rlabs kyi dpe lnga dang sbyor ste/ ri gzar 'bab chu dang*/ rong khung dog mo'i chu dang*/ phu gsum rdzing chu dang*/ mtsho chung rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ mtsho chen brlabs dang bral ba lta bu'o/ /sems 'grel du/ dngul chu me dang phrad pa'i dpe lngas gsungs te/ du ba rtseg rtseg sbal pa 'phyong*/ /'dar dang g.yo ba med pa'o| |zhes te/ 'ching byed kyi rdzas dang bcas te me dang phrad na/ dang por du bar byas te 'bros pa dang*/ gnyis par rtseg sgra 'byin pa dang*/

gsum pa sbal pa 'phyong pa lta bu dang*/ bzhi par g.yo zhing 'gul ba dang*/ lnga par de med pa'o// sems nyams lnga po 'di'i dus kyi rlung nyams dang lus nyams ni/ dang po gnyis la rlung cung zad 'thums nas shugs ring 'don/ lus ro stod dang mgo bo na/ lus gnad mi bde/ gsum pa la rlung res 'ga' gnas kyang res 'ga' rgyu bas sems gnas la gnod/ lus cung zad mi bde yang lus gnad la zug med| bzhi pa la/ 'dus rlung gnyis yod par res tshor res mi tshor/ lnga pa la ma brtag na gtan mi tshor/ brtag na cung zad tshor ba'am gtan mi tshor ba yang 'byung ngo*/ de ltar sems nyams lnga po de la/ rnam rtog ngos zin dang*/ ngal bso dang*| thang chad dang*/ rlabs bcas dang*/ rlabs med kyi nyams lnga zhes kyang zer| zhi byed rgyud pa phyi ma dgagayo/ thob/ goms/ brtan mthar phyin pa'i nyams zhes zer ro/ /de nas du sogs gsal po rim can du 'byung ba'i dus kyi lus nyams sems nyams gsum tha dad 'byung tshul ni/ du ba'i dus su| lus lci/ sems rmugs/ rmi lam sa khung du nyal ba sogs so/ /smig sgyu'i dus su| lus bsil/ sems 'phro/ gnas dang bde sdug res rmi lam chu la rgal ba sogs so/ /me khyer gyi dus su/ lus dro/ sems 'phro zhing gsal/ rmi lam me 'bar ba sogs so/ mar me'i dus su/ lus yang*/ sems mi mngon/ rmi lam 'phur ba sogs so/ /de rjes rtags de nyid dam/ nyin rtags dang po'i sbyor ba yin pas/ der bsdu dgos pa sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'i dus dang nyin rtags 'bar ba lta bu gnyis ka la/ lus shin tu mi mngon/ sems gsal zhing rtog med rig tsam las mi mngon/ rmi lam nam mkha' rgya chen po dang*/ der nyi zla gsal ba sogs so/ /de bzhin du zla nyi sgra gcan thig le rnams kyi tshe/ lus gsal dwangs 'phur nus pa dang*/ bde drod rgyas pas skom tshad 'bar ba dang*/ 'jam zhing gnyen la ci 'dod las su rung ba dang*/

brtan par gnas shing sgul mi thub pa rnams 'byung zhing*/ sems gsal la stong pa dang*/ shin tu gsal zhing spro thung ba dang*/ mtho dman cung zad byed pa dang*/ gsal zhing brtan pa rnams 'byung rmi lam rnams ni/ sngar gyi du sogs lnga po go zlog pa ste/ nyin bar gyi rtags rnams sna bug g.yon gyi rlung lnga po spro rim du gnas pa thim pa'i rtags yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan gyi sems gyi 'jog tshul gyi shes byed/ 'grel chen gnyis nas gsungs pa 'khrid yig tu bris pa bzhin dang*/ snyan rgyud du/ stong nyid sems 'jug shes rab ste/ /dngos rnams sems 'dzin rtog pa'o/ /de 'dzin 'jug pa spyod pa ste/ /kun la sems bzhag dga' ba'o/ /bde ba phun tshogs g.yo med bde/ /zhes dang*/ dpal nā ro pas/ gsang 'dus 'grel par/ shes dang shes byas 'byung ba zad pa ni/ sems gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i mtshan nyid sems rtse gcig nyid ni/ rang sems ces pas shes rab bstan pa/ khams gsum pa rab tu gsal ba tsam nyid kyi lan gcig sems pa tsam ni 'byung ba yin la/ de rtogs shing khong du chud pa ni gsang ba gsum 'byung ste/ de nyid ni rtog pa'o/ zhes dang*/ rtog pa'i yul de la rab sbyor longs spyod pa ste/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba bum pa dang snam bu la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi dngos po 'dzin pa ni dpyod pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ dga' ba rab gsal ni/ dpyod pa'i yul dngos po thams cad la sems gnas pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i yid bde ba'o/ /zhes dang*| bde ba bsdus pa zhes pa/ sems gnas pa'i dngos po thams cad la bde bas yang dag par rtogs pa lus shin tu sbyangs pa'i rgyu can gyi bde ba ni bde ba bsdus pa'o/ /zhes so/ 'di'i myong rtags ni/ longs sku nges pa gsum ldan nam lnga ldan te/ gnas re khā'am thig le phra mo'i nang du ngo bo stong gzugs/ rnam pa mtshan dpe/ dus nam 'dod/ yon tan 'od zer lnga ldan mthong la/

stong gzugs dang de snang mkhan gyi sems rtse gcig tu 'dres nas dbyer med pa dang*| du sogs nas longs sku'i bar dang*/ de nas bum snam la sogs pa rnam pa thams cad pa ste mtha' yas pa pra phab pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin du gsal dwangs snang la rang bzhin med par ma zad/ 'di'i rjes la 'di snang gi nges pa sus kyang 'chos mi nus par 'char ba rnams la/ sor bsdud kyi skabs su 'di dang 'di snang ngo snyam pa'i rtog par rags pa 'byung yang 'dir rtog med/ sngar bas gsal zhing dwangs pa 'byung la gtso bor mngon shes lnga 'char zhing*/ lus thogs med/ 'phur ba sogs kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang*/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa sogs kyang 'byung mod kyi/ phar phyin theg pa la grags pa'i lha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes lhag dang bcas pa'i steng du/ de la 'byung mi srid pa'i dri ro reg gsum sna tshogs rgyang ring thung dang phra rags mang po'i rig pa'i dbang po gzugs can phyi ma gsum la rten pa'i mngon shes 'byung*/ 'di nam byung ba nas sngags kyi tshogs lam chen po thob/ stong gzugs kyi sangs rgyas du ma la chos nyan pa sogs 'byung ste kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus la sogs pa bzhin no/ /srog rtsol gyi sems gyi 'jog tshul/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa la/ bla ma snga ma rnams 'jug gnas ldang gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum dang sbyor zhing*/ stod 'grel gyi lung drangs pa rnams su yang*/ oṃ yig gis 'jug pa dang*/ hūm̐ yig gis dgang ba dang*/ āḥyig gis 'byung ba zhes drangs mod/ kho bos mthong ba'i stod 'grel gnyis gsum du/ 'byung 'jug rjes pa sha stag byung la/ 'byung ba ni g.yon dang 'jug pa ni g.yas kyi rlung la sbyar ba'i skabs mang zhing*/ khyad par gong du dbye ba bshad pa'i lung gis gsal bar grub pa dang*/ khyad par rlung sbyor mtha' dag rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i thabs yin cing de yang nang du ma bsdus par mi 'grub la/

bzlas pa'i tshig mtha' nang du gnas pa dang sbyar na de legs par grub kyi/ phyir btang ba dang sbyar na mi 'grub pa rigs pa'i gtso bo yin pas legs par yid ches par bya zhing*/ gzhan yang oṃ yig zla ba dang*/ āḥyig nyi ma dang*/ hūm̐ yig sgra gcan du grub cing*/ gzhi la g.yon zla ba'i rlung phyi ru 'byung rim dang*/ g.yas nyi ma'i rlung nang du 'jug rim yin pa dang shin tu mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /de yin par gang gis shes zhe na/ sna bug gi bar gyi ka ba ni gnyis ka'i g.yon yin par gsal bar gsungs pas shes te/ srog chags zhig rgyab mchu la gtad nas g.yon nas phyir mthon zhing g.yas nas nang du 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /de bzhin du gang dag rdor bzlas kyi dus su a ba dhū tī nas 'byung 'jug byed par mos pa nges par dgos te/ de lta min na kyal stong brdabs pa lta bur 'gyur bas lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdor bzlas su mi 'gro'o zhes/ 'di dang lam 'bras la sogs pa gzhung khungs thub nas gsungs shing*| mkhas grub tshogs pas thugs nyams su deng sang gi bar la bzhes pa'i rnal 'byor dag la sdang smras byed pa ni/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs la thog mar snying gi sna rtser sngags kyi thig le'i srog rtsol bsgoms pas rlung dbu mar zhugs zin pa'i rjes su gdong gi sna rtser 'od kyi thig le srog rtsol bsgom pa na dbu ma nas dngos gnas 'byung 'jug byed pa bzhin du rdor bzlas la yang bya bar sgron gsal sogs su yang yang gsungs pa de'i rgya 'gebs rdor zlas mthong tshad la byar mi rung ste/ byas na spyir dngos gnas la med pa'i rtog sgom du 'gyur ba dang*/ rtsa bzang gis u tshugs byas na smyo 'bogs sogs kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /kyal stong brdabs pa ltar mthong ba 'dis ni nang rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs rags pa yang ma go ste/ lus kyi sbubs stong phal pa nas ro la 'byung ba'i rlung*/

nor las rgyal gyi cha shas cung zad 'byung gi rgyu zhing 'pho ba'i rlung thams cad ni ro rkyang dbu ma gsum gyi nang nas 'grims te/ rtsa 'khor rnams kyi 'phrang shar nas/ sna bug gi g.yas g.yon dang gnyis ka'i dbus nas 'byung 'jug byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na re shig dang por gang nas rgyu ba de nyid la gzhi dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor byas pas rnal 'byor de nyid kyi nus pas glo bur gyi gzhi'i bya byed thams cad je phrar song nas mthar gzhi'i bzang shos gnyug ma'i gzhi dang lam 'jal te/ yon tan je rgyas kyi ngang nas 'bras bu mngon du byed pa yin pas/ rang rang gi lam tshul bzhin du bsgrubs shig de bzhin du bskyed rim pas phreng sngags bzlo ba'i tshe yang*/ sngags kyi snying khar sngags phreng bkod pa las phyir 'phros pa sna bug g.yon pa nas zla ba'i rang bzhin dkar po lugs 'byung tu 'thon pas sangs rgyas mchod pa dang sems can sbyong ba la sogs pa'i phrin las byas te/ nyi ma'i rang bzhin dmar po lugs las bzlog par sna bug g.yas pa nas zhugs te sngar bzhin 'khor bar dmigs te ngag tu yang brjod na/ ngag gis phreng sngags tshar gcig song ba'i ring la dbugs 'byung rngub tu song ba'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'gro bas/ zhag gcig la rtsa sngags nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dang*/ nyin zhag lnga na 'bum brgyad stong dang*/ lnga brgya na bye ba gcig dang 'bum phrag brgyad 'gro bar gsungs shing*| des lus dag pa dang*/ de 'dra gzhan gnyis kyis ngag dang yid kyang dag nas dbug g.yo ba med par gyur te/ rdzogs rim pa'i rdor bzlas gzhan ma byas kyang bum pa can gyi gnas skabs thob par gsungs na de la yang dbu ma nas 'byung 'jug gi mos pa mi dgos shing*/ 'dis kyang 'byung 'jug gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyi gdangs su grub nas/ nyi zla sgrub pa las kyang*/ sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /lam du bya ba'i rim pa ni/

/'byung dang 'jug dang gnas pa gsum/ /yi ge gsum gyis rtsa lam sbyang*/ /zhes pas kyang shin tu gsal lo/ /bum pa can ni/ sgrub ler/ kha yang bkab ste sna yi bu ga gnyis ka dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung ni ma lus pa/ /srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa'i thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas pa/

/dus kyi goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las zla ba nyi ma me'i dbus su ro ni mnyam par 'gyur// lus la zas la sogs pa dang ni bkres dang skom pa 'phrog ste 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ster/ /zhes byed tshul dang phan yon gnyis ka bshad la/ grangs tshad yun tshad ni rgyud sdom 'byung nas bshad do/ /phan yon gzhan yang*/ nang ler/ nyi ma zla ba 'gog pa mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod pa la ste dbu ma me la rab tu zhugs| |srog dang thur sel gnyis po dag kyang nyin zhag dang por zhugs na dus min 'chi ba slu ba ste/ /lag pa dang ni rkang pa'i mthe bo'i tshigs dang sor mo'i mthar ni srog gis kun tu gang byas nas/ /'khor lo drug la sangs rgyas lha mo 'jig med lag pa'i pad+mo rnal 'byor pa yis sgom par bya/ /zhes srog thur rags pa lte bar bltams nas ye shes kyi rlung phra mos rkang lag gi sen mo'i bar gyi rtsa phran mtha' dag gang bar bsgoms pa'i bum pa can la 'bad na tshe sgrub kyi mchog tu 'gyur ba sogs kyang mang du gsungs pas rlung sbyor gyi rgyal po 'di la 'bad par bya la/ de bzhin du rlung sbyor btsan thabs rgyan can gyi lag len mang du yod pa gegs sel gyi nang du bshad par bya'o/ /chos rje bla ma dam pas 'gal rkyen 'gog pa'i 'chi bslu rgyas pa dang*/ de la 'phros pa'i rtsa chad 'chi ltas/ mthun rkyen sgyub pa la 'phros nas nang le'i nad sel ba'i rlung sbyor sman sbyor bcud len la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs pa ni kho bos spyi don du de las kyang rgyas par bshad zin pas der blta'o/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyi 'jog tshul la/ 'jog pa rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su byed par kun mthun zhing nges par dgos bzhin du skabs 'dir rtsa 'khor gsal mi 'debs pa'ang mi 'thad la/ dbye ba lngar nges pa'ang mi 'thad de/ nye ba'i sgrub pa yan lag drug /ces pa 'dzin pa'i dbye bar ma byas na 'chad mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /go rim sor bsam gyis dpral bar rlung 'dus pa dang sbrel nas sgom dgos pas na thog mar gtsug tor dang dpral ba'i 'dzin pa sgom zhes gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad de/

spyir 'dzin pa ni srog rtsol bum pa can mthar phyin pa'i dngos 'bras yin la/ de'i nus pa'i gtso bo ni/ nyi zla'i rlung lte ba'i dbu mar zhugs pa nyid yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'dzin pa drug po yang sa chu dang chu me la thim pa la sogs pa'i rim pas bsgom dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ sor bsam gyi nus pa yang*/ sa chu la thim pa la sogs pa ma byung na du sogs mi 'char la/ de dag thim pa yang lte ba na 'pho chung lnga'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab na gnas pa'i phyir ro| |der ma zad 'dzin pa thams cad rlung sbyor bum pa can dang sbyar nas sgom dgos na/ srog rtsol gyi skabs su lte ba'i bum pa can ma gtogs rtsa 'khor gzhan gyi bum pa can la bshad pas gtsug tor dang dpral pa'i bum pa can de ma thag nas byar mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /'di'i spogs chog gi gzhung yang*/ nā da goms pas btsan thabs chu skyes su gnas/ /rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas bsgrub par bya/ /zhes sogs kyis ston cing*/ 'chi med sgrub pa'ang*/ dpral bar thig le dkar po dbyangs kyis yongs su bskor ba bdud rtsi spro bar byed pa yis kyang ngo*/ /zhes sogs kyis ston te/ de ltar yan lag 'di gnyis ni rlung sems gnyis las gtso bor rlung la dmigs shing de yang sor bsam la ltos te cung zad rtsub pas/ lam 'di la dpa' bo'i rim pa dang sor bsam la bdag byin brlabs zhes gsungs te/ bskyed rim gyi skabs su de gnyis lha khro bo dang zhi ba'i sgrubs thabs la gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na dus zhabs pas/ kun la drug drug shes bya ste/ /rab kyis dang po rtogs pas so/ /'bring gis srog rtsol la sogs yin/ /tha mas drug po rim pas so/ /zhes pa la brten nas/ dbang po rab sor sdud rkyang pas dang*/ 'bring gis de dang srog rtsol gyis dang*/ tha mas drug ka bsgom dgos zhes pa/ sgra ji bzhin du rgya bod mang po 'dod pa ni/ grangs nges bshad par ltar mi rigs te/

lam gyi yan lag cha ma tshang ba la ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang sngon du legs par goms pas ni tshe 'dir rtsol ba chen po mi dgos pa tsam la dgongs nas/ gzhung lugs gzhan du yang lam cig car ba'i rnam gzhag mang du gsungs pa ltar 'dir yang ngo*/ khyad par rjes dran 'dzin pa'i dngos 'bras su phyag na rdo rjes gsal bar gsungs pas 'dzin pa med pa'i rjes dran mi rung ngo*/ /rjes dran gyi gzhung ni/ dbang mdor bstan du/ 'chi ltas slu ba rnal 'byor pa'i/ /'di ni dga' ba rnams kyis 'gyur/ /mgo bo'i pad+mar gtsug tor las/ khu ba 'ongs pa dga' ba ste/ /mgrin pa snying khar mchog dga'o/ /dga' bral dga' ba de nas 'gyur| |sna tshogs dga' ba lte ba dang*/ /gsang ba'i pad+mar gang 'ongs pa'o// gsang gnas rdo rje nor bur ni/ /lhan cig skyes dga' mi 'pho ba/ /zhes dang*/ ye ler/ rlung gnyis yang dag phrad pa rnams kyis glog gi me yi rtse mos spyi bo'i zla bar zhu bar byed/ /thig le gang gang zhu ba 'di nas mgrin pa snying khar sa bon lte ba gsang ba la 'gag go /thig le las ni g.yo ba'i khu ba rdo rje nor bu la gnas rgyal mtshan rtse la 'gog pa gang*/ /de ni shes rab ye shes gal te thig le'i phreng ba g.yo ba med pas bde na'o/ /zhes pa yas babs kyi mthar thug thig le 'pho med kyi bde chen 'di rjes dran mthar thug tu gsungs na yang mkhas pa dag thig le 'pho med ces pas 'khrul nas ting nge 'dzin du bzhed pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'di dbang ler drang don gyi dbang bzhi pa ngos 'dzin pa na/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bur chud pa'i bde ba rtogs pa ni bzhi pa'o zhes gsungs shing*/ bzhi pa de ni 'jig rten pa'i lam du gsungs pa'i phyir te/ /ye ler| shes rab ye shes nu ma la reg gzhan pa bdud rtsi myang dang 'khyud pa gang yin pa/ /de dag dang 'grogs byang chub sems ni zhu ba la yang bzhi pa'i skad cig

bdud rtsi tshogs pa gang*/ /de dag thams cad nges par 'jig rten pa ste mchog gi snying rje yis ni lam gyi rgyu ru bstan/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang gang mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rgya mchog la rjes su sbyor ba'o/ /zhes drang don bzhi pa'i skad cig tha ma yang 'jig rten pa'i lam du gsungs pas so// gal te ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag dang 'jig rten pa'i gzhi mthun 'dod pas skyon med do zhe na/ 'di ni bod thams cad zhal mthun lta bur snang mod kyi shin tu mi 'thad de/ dbang bskur ba 'jig rten pa'i bcu dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bskur ba bcu gcig pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa zhes sogs ting nge 'dzin la 'das lam gyis khyab par lan mang du gsungs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi skad cig stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis kyis 'pho ba stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis kyi sa bon spong dgos la/ sa bon spong pa'i lam la 'das lam gyis khyab pa gzhung lugs mtha' dag nas 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'grel chen du/ bar pa'i mtshan ma ni/ 'gyur ba med pa'i skad cig brgya phrag bco brgyad kyis ma mthong ba'i don mthong ba dang mngon shes lnga la sogs pa thob par bshad la/ ma mthong ba'i don mthong ba ni/ mthong lam las ma 'das pas de ma rdzogs kyi bar du mthong lam mi thob par bshad pa ci zhe na/ ma mthong ba'i don mthong ba mthong lam la byed mi dgos te/ dgos na mchog mi 'gyur du| sa re res kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mang po'i don mthong par bshad pas sa re re la yang mthong lam re re khas len dgos par 'gyur zhing*/ mngon shes kyang sngar ma thob par 'gyur te der thob par bshad pas so/ /'dod na bsam gtan mthar phyin nas mngon shes lnga ka 'grub par lan mang du bshad pa de dang 'gal lo/ /des na/ rjes dran gyi mthar thug la so skye'i ya mtha' dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dang po la 'phags pa'i ma mtha' byed pa 'di gzhung snga ma de dag gi bstan don dang rigs pas kyang legs par grub pa yin no/

/bsten bya phyag rgya'i nang nas/ nang gi dam tshig phyag rgya ni/ sngar dbye ba'i skabs su drangs pa'i/ ye le'i/ glog gi dbyug pa'i rjes mthun 'pho med bde ba skyed par byed la mtshan nyid yan lag yongs su rdzogs/ zhes dang*/ sgrub ler/ gtum mo lte ba'i 'khor lo dgu yis bsnun pa'i lag 'gro tsartsi ka sogs lhag pa'i lha dang ldan// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis bstan pa/ lte ba'i dmar cha cung zad g.yas phyogs na gnas pa nang gi nyi ma bden don bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid/ ho yig ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin/ rnam par bcad pa'i tsheg drag gi rnam pa can te/ /spro byed nub pa'i ngo bo glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gis gzi brjid can/ /ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs kyis gsungs pa ste/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che dang*/ /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /zhes pa'i bstan bya gzhi lam 'bras gsum thams cad du bsngags pa ste/ de bzhin du de'i thabs ni/ rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od dang*/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu gcig rig/ces pa'i bstan bya| dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po zhes sogs kyi don te/ phyi nang gzhan gsum mtha' dag 'di gnyis su legs par 'du bas dus kyi 'khor lo'i snying po yin pas nang gi nyi zla mi nyams shing rgyas pa la 'bad par bya ba yin no/ /las rgya ni/ dbang ler/ pho nya mo rnams kyi dris ma lus dang pad+ma la gnas de dag rnams ni rigs lnga ste/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan pa ste/ rigs/ ming*| dri/ lus/ lo/ yon tan no/ /rigs ni lnga ste/ dbyings phyug sgrol ma| gos dkar/ mā ma ki spyan no/ /ming ni/ dpal ldan bzang mo/ pad ma can| dung can ma/ sna tshogs ma/ glang chen ma'o/ /dri ni lus sam/ skye gnas la| gla rtsi/ pad+ma*/ dri chu/ sha rul ba'i dri'o/ /lus ni rim bzhin/ yan lag dang skra phra/

rkang lag 'jam/ snying rje che ba rnams dang*/ yan lag phra la ring*/ mig 'dzum la bul/ skra li ba rnams dang*/ skra thung la sbom/ rtsod pa la dga'/ ngo tsha chung zhing chags pa che ba rnams dang*/ skra dang yan lag ring zhing tshad la skye gnas snyi ba dang*/ skra dang yan lag sbom zhing thung skye gnas skya ba rnams so// yon tan ni/ bla ma dang rgyud la dad/ sgyu rtsal sbyangs/ dbang gis legs par smin pa ste/ rgyud gzhan dang rtsa rgyud du'ang gsungs la/ bud med zla ba'i bzhin ldan sogs kyis kyang gsungs/ de bzhin du skyes pa'am/ rnal 'byor pa yang*/ rigs| mi skyod/ don grub/ rin 'byung*/ dpag med/ rnam snang ste ming*/ seng ge ri dwags/ rta/ khyu mchogaglang chen rnams lus dbyibs dang dri de dag dang 'dra la/ blo rigs blo brtan zhing dben pa la dga' la/ gtong phod dang 'jigs sran che ba dang*/ sems brdar zhing 'gros mgyogs pa dang*/ gzhan gyi las la 'khol zhing 'dod chags che ba dang*/ blun zhing mig 'dzum la 'gros bul ba dang*/ shin tu rmongs shing chags pa che la 'gros dal ba rnams te/ rigs ma 'dres pa rnams la ji bzhin dang 'dres pa la ci rigs su gsungs so| |gzhan yang*/ bde dgyes/ rdo rje phreng ba/ zhal lung rnams na shin tu gsal lo/ /ye rgya byin gyis rlob tshul sogs ni/ sgrub le'i thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi 'grel par rtsa rgyud drangs nas shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa mngon rtogs su bris pa ltar ro/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi shes byed ni/ yul stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'i ngo bo ngos 'dzin/ sgrub ler/ phyag rgya sgyu ma'i rjes su mthun la yid dang nam mkha' la ni me long dag la skye bzhin no/ /'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed cing dri med glog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro bar byed// phyi dang lus la dbyer med yul dang rnam par bral ba'i snang ba tsam ni mkha' la gnas pa yi/ /sems dang sems byung la ni bdag gi 'khyud de 'gro ba du ma'i gzugs can de ni gcig pu'o/

/snying ni rnyog pa dang bcas las kyi phyag rgya 'di dang btags pa'i ye shes phyag rgya btang byas te/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub slad du rgyal ba mchog gi bskyed ma mchog gi phyag rgya gos pa med/ /rnam pa 'gyur ba med cing mkha' mnyam mun bcom khyab byed rnal 'byor ngag gi bgrod bya ther zug gnas/ /ye shes gzi brjid srid pa'i dri ma 'phrog byed dus kyi 'khor lo rjes su rig pa sgom par bya/ /zhes dang*/ sa la sogs pa rnams ni kun nas 'bigs byed dri med nor bu dang mtshungs stong pa gcig pu ste/ /thog ma med cing mtha' med dbus kyang med la yul med yul ni sgrubs pa dus kyi 'khor lo'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ ye ler/ sems kyi snang ba tsam ste rang gi yid la skyes pa me long gi ni gzugs brnyan lta bu nyid/ /gang zhig mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsten pa rnal 'byor dbang pos bsten bya ste/ /ye shes me lce rab tu rgyas pa 'di ni bdud tshogs yul dang bcas pa mtha' dag bsreg byed cing*/ /lus la chags pa la sogs kyang ste lo yi sbyor bas rnal 'byor pa la bde mnyam ster bar byed/ /ces dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang bral ba dag ste sems ni gzhan pa min pa nyid/ /ces dang*| gang phyir a sogs ka sogs ri bong can dang nyin byed gcig nyid rdo rje can gyi gdan min zhing*/ /hūm̐ yig nyid kyis mtshan ma dang ni yongs su gyur pa'i gzhan pa'i khog gzugs dag mi 'dod/ /'gyur med dag gis bskyed cing 'gyur ba nyams par gyur pa mchog gi dbang po dag dang ldan pa ni/ /rnam pa kun ldan mtha' dag thig le mchog gi rgyal ba'i bdag po sna tshogs sgyu ma 'dzin pa 'di la'o/ /zhes pas gsungs la/ pra phab pa'i rnam pa can/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud| |zhes sogs dang*/

mtshan brjod du/ gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ /zhes sogs dang*/ lus med lus te lus kyi mchog/sogs dang*| rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med sogs dang*/ 'grel chen du/ de bzhin du gzhan nang gi rig pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba| phyag rgya chen mo lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i gzugs can ma/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyu mthun pa rdzogs pa'i gnas skabs te/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas kyi yum rten/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa/ mchog gi dbang po'i spyod yul mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i rang bzhin rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa me long gi pra phab pa dang rmi lam dang mtshungs pa de dag ni rgyal ba rnams kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gsungs te/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin gyi phyir ro zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams kyi bstan don/ nyer len shin tu phra ba'i rlung ngam/ spro byed nus pa'i ngo bo'i ming can gzhi'i bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis pa rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che'i bdag nyid stong gzugs bzhin lag gi rnam pa can du gdod ma nas bzhugs pa'i rkyen gyis gsar du 'dus ma byas pa de nyid rkyen zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis dri ma sbyangs pas mngon du gyur pa/ ngo bo bde chen nyid der shar ba yin gyi ma dag las snang gi gzung 'dzin bzhin du yul dang yul can du ma grub cing*/ las snang gi dbang po'i yul las 'das pa/ yon tan rlung 'od zer lnga pa'i ye shes 'od zer gyis srid gsum gyi bem chos mtha' dag bsreg cing dag pa'i srid gsum gcig car du snang bar nus pas thams cad la kun rdzob tsam du cha med du khyab cing*/ kun tu 'gro yang rnal 'byor pa rang snang ba rang nyid yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par lte bar langs nas 'gyur med kyi bde chen sbyin par mdzad pa'i yum chen mo sher phyin no/

/sher phy-in shes pa yin pas lha skur mi 'thad do snyam na/ 'di ni bye mdo gnyis kyi grub mtha'i 'dod pa'i gzugs la bem pos khyab par 'dod pa'i rab rib kyis mig sdongs par zad de| mdo sde rgyan du/ me long ye shes kyi ngo bo ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe yang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nyid me long ye shes su gsungs la/ seng bzang gis kyang byang chub chen por bshad pa sogs dang*| rgyud sde rnams su ni yum chen mo'i zhal phyag mang du gsungs pas so// des na gang dag gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgyu lus phung po rnying pa las bye bar gsungs pas 'khrul nas phung po'i phyi ru nges par grub dgos par 'dod pas kyang 'di gdos bcas bem po'i gzugs su bzung bar zad do/ /des na 'di 'dra'i snang ba 'di deng sang kha cig tshad grub tu 'dod pa'i sngo sogs kyi snang ba ma 'gag na mthong mi srid pa'i yang dag kun rdzob yin pas 'di snang ba'i ye shes la gnyis snang gi dri ma dang bden snang bden 'dzin cung zad kyang med do// yul can mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen ni/ rigs rgyu yan lag dang po bzhi dang las ye'i phyag rgya la yang brten mod kyi dngos rgyu stong gzugs phyag chen kho na las grub pa/ rten thig le 'gyur med la brten pa ste/ dbang mdor bstan du/ khu ba mi 'gyur rang bzhin gyis/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bsgrub par bya/ /rten ni 'pho ba thob pa na/ /brten pa'i 'dod chags bral ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pas so// yang 'di la rten nas rten dang brten pa tha dad dang*/ rten 'di rtsa dbu ma'i nang du mar khu brtsegs pa bzhin du brtseg dgos par smra zhing de ltar go ba de gzhan la ston mi nus pa skad du gdams pa'i mchog tu 'dzin pa dag gis kyang*/ 'di'i rten khu ba de gdos bcas kyi bem por gzung bar zad la/ rgyud de ka'i 'jug tu*/ rten dang brten pa legs rdzogs pas/

/ji srid 'gyur med nyid du 'gro| |sems kyis 'gyur med nyid thob na/ /rten dang brten pa'i mtshan nyid med| |ces 'gyur med thob nas rten dang brten pa med par gsungs pa ma go bar nges so/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor pa'i snang ngor nor bu'i rtse nas gsang gnas kyi rtsa 'khor dang*/ de nas lte ba dang*/ de nas snying kha dang*/ de nas mgrin pa dang*| de nas dpral ba dang*/ de nas gtsug tor gyi bar la bde chen stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gnyis gnyis mas brtan gyi tshul du 'phel bas sa bcu gnyis thob pa ni gsal bar gsung te/ sgrub ler/ chags dang chags bral mtha' thog la gnas skad cig ma yang khyab bdag gi ni dbugs kyi grangs 'phel lo/ /gsang bar rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo las skad cig ma brgya phrag sum cu rtsa drug rnams kyis 'phel te/ de'i grangs kyi srog rnams gsad nas gsang ba'i pad+ma de yis sa gnyis su 'gyur te/ de bzhin du lte ba dang snying kha dang mgrin pa dang dpral ba bzhi dang drug dang brgyad dag sa bcu rnams su 'gyur zhing*/ gtsug tor du srog thams cad zad pas sa bcu gnyis so zhes so/ 'dir bla ma mkhas pa dag dang po'i stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gcig yas babs nyid du zhal 'cham pa ni/ gsang bar rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo las ces pa'i lung la dngos su 'gongs shing*/ nor bu'i rtse nas gsang ba'i bar la sa gnyis mi dgos na/ rtsa 'khor gzhan rnams la gnyis gnyis su nges pa 'gal lo/ der ma zad phrag dang pos sa dang po thob ces gsung pa la/ dang po rab dga' thob bo zhes rgya bod mang po gsung ba ni/ shes rab kyis chags pa las byung ba mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i skad cig ma rnam kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa 'di rnams thob te zhes sogs dang*/ /de bzhin du nyon mongs bdud rnams bcom byas nas rdzu 'phrul dang kun mkhyen gyi sa bcu gnyis 'chad par 'gyur ba rnams dang*/ srid gsum bla ma nyid ces pa zhes sogs 'dir bstan gyi sa bcu gnyis po de bzhin gshegs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi sar gsungs shing*/

sngar brjod pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan stobs bcu dang sa bcu gnyis dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi zhes gsungs pas gnod la/ dbang bcu gcig gi sngags don dang shin tu 'gal te/ dbang bdun gyis rab dga' sogs bdun dang*/ bum dbang gis brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang*/ gsang dbang gis dgu pa rgyal bu gzhon nu dang*/ gsum pas bcu pa chos kyi sprin dharma me gha zhes gsungs la/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi lam mthar thug ni rjes dran yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du stong gzugs ldang pa nor bu'i rtser mo mdzad pa la yang*/ 'khrid yig tu bshad pa'i phyag rdor gyi lung gis legs par gnod pas chen po dag gi bzhed pa yin kyang sems 'grel dang ma mthun par mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen dang a bha ya kā ra sogs kyang 'gog na gzhan dag mi dgyes pa mdzad rgyur zad do/ /de bzhin du rtsa rgyud 'grel chen du drangs pa dang dbang mdor bstan dang*/ rgyud phyi ma rnams las 'gyur med nyi khri chig stong drug brgyas 'pho chags kyi sa bon de snyed 'joms pa dang*/ rtsa 'khor drug tu sa zung rdzogs tshul gsungs te de dag tu blta'o| |tshad ma drug gi shes byed ni/ spyir rdzogs rim dngos la mngon sum bskyed rim dngos la rtog pas khyab pa ni rdo rje snying 'grel du rtog pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang bas ches gsang zhes pa bla med la zhugs pa yi yang bskyed rim pa la gsang ba la dgongs pa'i phyir dang*/ klu sgrub yab sras kyis/ dang por sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa/ gnyis pa dran pa gcig pa/ gsum pa rtog pa'i rnal 'byor/ bzhi pa lus rnam par dben pa zhes sogs/ bskyed rim gyi bzang shos phra mo rnal 'byor yang rtog par bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par sgrub ler/ lha yi dmigs pa dag kyang mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/

/mngon sum min na rjes su dpag pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni rtags pa gang*/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis rdzogs rim la mngon sum dang de kho na nyid yid byed dang bskyed rim la rjes dpag dang*/ mos pa yid byed du gsal bar gsungs la/ snying 'grel du/ de yongs shes pas ni/ dngos po med pa bsgom par bya ba ste rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba'i sems kyis snang brnyan mthong ba/ rtog pa dang bral zhing ma 'khrul pa ste mngon sum zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nyid rnam pa bzhi ste/ dbang po'i mngon sum dang yid kyi mngon sum dang rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum dang*/ rang rig pa'i mngon sum zhes pa ste/ shes pa de nyid ni nye bar ston par byed pa dang*/ 'jug par byed pa dang*/ thob par byed pa dang*/ nyams su myong ba'i mtshan nyid can no| |zhes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas spyir rdzogs rim la mngon sum gyis khyab pa dang*/ khyad par bsnyen bsgrub bzhi po mngon sum bzhir gsungs la/ bla ma rnams kyang 'di sgra ji bzhin bzhed mod/ rgyu mtshan gyi tshig ma brtag na/ gsum pa 'phags lam thob byed du gsungs pa 'dis/ rnal 'byor mngon sum btags pa dang*/ bzhi pa myang ngor gsungs pas chos dbyings nyams su myong ba'i rnal 'byor mngon sum dngos su grub pa dang*/ ming rtog ge la grags pa bzhin du/ mtshan nyid rjes mthun pa yang der grags pa bzhin du bzhed dgos la| rnal 'byor mngon sum ni bzhi pa nyid du phyogs glang yab sras kyis gsal bar gsungs shing*/ so skye la de mi srid pas kyang kho bos ji skad bshad pa bzhin 'dod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rgyud tshig 'di'i 'grel chen du/ 'dir dang por las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor pas mngon par shes pa med par sha'i mig gis mthong ngo/ /de nas mngon par shes pa'i mtshams kyi dbang gis lha'i mig gis mthong ngo*/ /de nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mtshams kyi dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis mthong ngo*/

/de nas byang chub sems dpa'i mtshams kyis dbang gis shes rab kyi spyan gyis mthong ngo/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi dbang gis ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs so// zhes pa'i dang po gnyis rim bzhin sor bsam so so dang de nas srog 'dzin la gcig dang dran ting la re re sbyar bar bya ba yin la/ 'di rnams kyang 'ching ba kun ldan dang*/ bsam gtan thob pa tsam dang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa dang*/ byang sems 'phags pa dang*/ phar phyin theg pa'i sangs rgyas dang sbyar bar bya ba yin gyi| chags bral ma dag sa bdun dang*/ byang sems dag pa sa gsum la sbyor zhing sbyor drug dang sgrig pa sha stag gi ngang la sngon chad 'das pa yang don gyis bkag zin to/ /dag dbye ni/ so sor bsdud pa rgyal ba'i dbang por 'gyur zhing rnam pa bcu ste zhes sogs kyis gsal bar gsungs la rigs pa yang*/ rnal 'byor drug po'i ngo bo ye shes nam mkha' rlung me chu sa drug tu rim pa ltar gnas pas dag bya'am spang bya'ang de'i phung sogs drug tshan no/ /'o na gnyen po phra rim chung rim nas skye ba rigs mod kyi spang bya rags rim nas 'gag dgos pa la phra rim du byung ba c-i zhe na/ 'dir rdzogs rim gyi spang bya'i gtso ba ni rlung dang de'i nang nas kyang thabs kyis ma zin na skyon bskyed byed kyi rlung gi gtso bo ye shes kyi rlung yin pas de dang por spong zhing*/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi yang*/ g.yas bsdud rim du rgyu ba ni yang sla bas zhor la dgag zhing g.yon bskyed rim du rgyu ba'i rlung gtso bor 'gog pa na phra rim nas 'gog par sems so/ /'bras bu ni/ dag bya rtogs pas 'bras bu bshad mi dgos par bde blag tu rtogs par nus so/ /'jug bsrung bsdoms drug ni/ gzhan rnams rtogs par sla la/ bstod 'grel nas gsungs pa'i dam tshig brgyad ni/ nges pa'i dngos grub rgyu rnams dang*/ /dam tshig rnams kyang bskyang ba dang*/

/rigs gzhan las byung pho nya mo/ /'dod la chags pas bgrod mi bya/ /gnyis med thogs pa med pa yi// dam tshig rnams kyi spyod pa dang*/ /yi mo'i spyod pa legs par bsrub/ /tshangs par spyod pa de bzhin zhal/ /'dren pa rtsa yi kun spyod do/ /zhes pa dam tshig brgyad du dran/ /rnal 'byor dbang po gang bsrung pa/ /myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas drang nges re re yang brgyad brgyad de/ drang don brgyad ni/ lam thun mong ba bsten pa dang*/ dam tshig can dang*/ tshogs 'khor gnyis med du bya ba dang*/ bsrung 'khor sogs kyis bgegs zhi ba dang*/ gnyis sbyor skabs su gang bab bya ba dang*/ 'dzag pa bsrung ba dang*/ nad sel ba sogs kyi don du mas brtan par bya ba'o/ /nges don brgyad ni/ 'pho med kyi bde chen spyir sgrub pa dang*/ khyad par thig le bzhi'i dga' ba bcu drug bskyed pa dang*| rigs ldan ma las gzhan dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ nya'i mtha' dang 'dra ba'i yas babs mthar thug bde stong gnyis med du bskyang ba dang*/ nag phyogs lta bu'i chags pa nyams pa spang ba dang*/ phyag chen la sbyor zhing gzhan don byed pa dang*/ thig le'i zhal sgo bzhir thig le 'pho med brtan par bya ba dang*/ mas brtan yongs su rdzogs pa la 'bad pa rnams te/ 'ga' zhig ni lam gyi dngos gzhir yang snang ngo*/ lam 'phrog pa'i chom rkun ni/ 'grel chen las/ lam bzang rin chen 'di ni bag med kyis/ /sems can gzhan pa dag la byin pa na| |rang khyim dgon pa dag tu rab bzhugs la/ /yul ngan chom rkun rnams kyis 'phrog par byed/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams shin tu gsal lo/ /de ltar sbyor dngos 'jug gsum ka la drug drug ste phar phyin theg pa dang ma 'dres pa'i lam gyi chos bco brgyad pa phrag drug ste/ brgyad lhag pa'i brgya dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ skal ba ches mchog tu 'gyur pa'i gang zag gis bgrod par bya ba/

rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs kyi yang snying*/ gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ de phyir brtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa shān+ti pa dang mkhas mchog rdo rje'i slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sogs kyi blo gros kyi ra bar yang ma shong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di'i lam mtha' dag ni/ thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen dang sku stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo'i lam gnyis su 'dus te/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'bras bu khyad par can gang bsgrub kyang de'i thabs dang shes rab gnyis cha tshang ba nges par dgos pa/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i lam ni de gnyis cha mnyam pas srid zhi gnyis 'gog cing 'bras bu sku gnyis sgrub bar lan gcig min par gsungs shing*/ 'dir yang*| gzugs kyis srid par mi 'ong ste/ /'gyur med mya ngan 'das mi 'gro / phan tshun 'khyud pa zhi ba ste/ /ma ning gi ni go 'phang mchog/ces gsungs pas so/ /'o na/ thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis gzugs sku dang shes rab ye shes kyi tshogs kyis chos sku bsgrub par gsungs la/ 'dir go bzlog pa ci zhe na/ de nyid kyis mchog tu grub ste/ re re yang phan tshun legs par rgyas gtab pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar/ srid pa ni ma dag 'khrul ba'i las snang phra rags nyid yin la/ /de ni dag pa 'od gsal phyag chen gyi snang bar gyur nas srid pa'i mtha' 'gog cing*/ zhi ba myang 'das ni/ rang bzhin gyi sdug bsngal mi 'gog par rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs tsam 'gog pa yin la/ de ni srid gsum bde chen gyi ye shes gcig tu gyur nas zil gyis mnan te/ 'od gsal dag pa'i rnam rol gyis gzhan don 'bad med du 'byung bas 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na 'di gnyis la shes rab dang snying rje'i don yang shin tu tshang ste/ bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i tha mal bem chos kyi 'dzin pa ni shes rab kyi spang bya yin la de stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mos spong zhing*/

sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa/ /snying rje chen po'o zhes snying rje'i byed las ni rang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal skyob pa yin la de mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen gyis byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang bde sdug ni/ rang yul sim gdung myong bas 'dzin stangs shin tu 'gal zhing 'gyur ba'i bde ba ni mthar sdug bsngal du 'gro bas de la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes kyang bya na mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ni de'i yang gnyen po mchog yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di gnyis med par lam gzhan gyis mtha' thug gi 'bras bu mi 'grub pa'i tshul ni spyi don mjug tu bkod zin to/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul ni/ ye ler/ lus ni dwangs zhing sdug sran nyams pa nam mkha' dang mtshungs mtshan la sogs pa rnams kyis rab rdzogs 'gyur// sna tshogs 'jig rten gsum po nyid ni dwangs zhing sgrib pa rnam par bral ba rmi lam bzhin du snang*/ /skad ni kun nas chad pa med pa du ma'i skad gzhan dag gis gzhan gyi snying la 'jug pa ste/ /sems ni dam pa'i bde bas gang zhig mi g.yo thams cad dus su lhan cig skyes pas 'khyud pa'o/ /zhes sku 'ja' lus ye shes kyi sku 'byung chos phra mo'i phra mo dang yang bral zhing*/ dag pa zag med kyi las snang yang ma 'dres pas sangs rgyas nang phan tshun kho na'i spyod yul gyi stong gzugs zhal sbyor te lhan skyes kyi sku'am ngo bo nyid sku'o/ /thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde chen sgrib pa phra mo'i phra mo las kyang grol ba'i ye shes chos kyi sku'o/ /gsung rnam pa thams cad pa'i skad du chos gsung ba gzhom med nā da'i mthar thug zag med las snang can gyi sa bcu'i byang sems dang*/ sa bcu gnyis kyi byang sems la thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i longs skur snang ba'o/ /phrin las gang la gang 'dul gyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang*/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs ston pa zag bcas ma dag pa'i las snang can la 'byung lus phra rags su snang ba sprul pa'i sku'o/

/'di bzhi lugs bzlog la sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang sprul longs chos bde'i skur yang bshad do/ /de 'grub tshul ni/ ye ler/ srog dang thur sel 'gags par gyur na ri bong 'dzin pa skyod pa nyi ma'i gzugs su rab tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje pad+ma rab tu sad na slar yang 'di ni nyi ma'i gzugs kyi me lces zhu bar byed/ /rlung dang zla ba nyi ma 'gags par gyur na rnam par shes pa dang ni ye shes gcig tu gyur/ /de ltar de ltar dang ni de bzhin de ltar rnam gsum du 'gyur gzhan ni cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes rgyu rkyen nang dang phyi'i phyag rgya la rten nas/ rlung sems thig le gsum gyi 'pho 'gyur phra mo yang 'gags te/ rnam shes sems dang ye shes rlung gi dwangs ma gcig tu 'dres pa de gzhi la gnas pa de ltar lam gyis kyang de lta nyid du bsgoms pas 'bras bu'i tshe yang de ltar te rnam pa gsum rdzogs par gyur pa 'di lta bu'i 'bras bu gzhan ni lam gzhan la cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin no/ /de 'grub pa'i dus ni/ zla ba nyi ma'i gzugs ni zos na mkha' la nyin mtshan dang ni mtshan mo nam yang min pa nyid/ /thun mtshams de ni lus kyi dbus su rnal 'byor rnams kyi lus kun bdud rtsi'i go 'phang la gnas pa'o/ /phyogs zad zla ba mkha' la gnas pa nyi ma'i gzugs la ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba ji lta bar/ /srog dang thur sel zad par gyur na gsal bar yang ni lus la dngos grub dus su de 'gag go /zhes nyin mo'i dmar lam dang mtshan mo zla ba'i dkar lam dang thun mtshams kyi mun nag gang yang min pa'i tho rengs kyi dus kyi thun mtshams su/ gnam gang la nyi zla ro mnyam du song pa bzhin du srog thur ro mnyam du 'gags nas dga' ba cha bcas lnga rdzogs pa'i bcu drug pa'i dus su'o/ /de 'grub pa'i rkyen ni/ zla ba nyi ma'i rgyu ba mnyam shing lam ni gnyis ka yi yang srog gi rlung ni chen po 'gags//

chu skyes rdo rje rab tu gsad cing ri bong can zhu nyi ma'i gzugs chen la ni rab tu zhugs| |dngos dang dngos med gcig 'gyur rnam gsum srid pa la gnas gzhom med legs par rab tu rtogs gyur pa/ /de yi dus su rnal 'byor pa de gang la gnyis ni cung zad med pa mchog gi go 'phang 'gro/ /zhes nang gi rkyen yan lag dang po bzhis rlung sbyangs/ lnga pas bde stong sbyar/ drug pas 'dzin stangs dngos dang dngos med gcig tu 'gyur pa'i stong nyid dang snang yul srid pa gsum la khyab pa'i stong gzugs rdzogs par rtogs pa'o/ /de ltar grub pa'i ltas ni/ khro bo sangs rgyas lha mo dang bcas nges par ro yi rdo rje rnams dang sa'i lha mo sogs/ /rab tu dga' ba'i thugs rnams rnal 'byor pa la grub pa'i dus su nam mkha' la ni mngon sum 'gyur/ /de yi 'dod pa'i dngos grub ri bong can gyi zhag gi tho rengs dang ni mtshan mo phyed la 'gyur/ /rin po che'am me tog char ni mchog gyur dus kyi sbyor bas sa'i steng du 'bab par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams go sla'o/ /'di dag saṃ bu ṭir yang cha mthun du gsungs so// de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i mthar thug rnams/ /rgyal bas mdo sngags gzhan du sbas pa las/ /gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lor sbas khungs gton/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyis byi dor mdzad/ /rgya bod mkhas grub mang pos nyams su myong*/ /rdo rje can dngos bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /mdo sngags spyi dang khyad par lugs mchog 'dir/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog spobs pas rab brgyan pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba bdag kyang skal ba bzang*| |de ltar spyi dang khyad par lung khungs dang*/ /rnam mang rigs pa'i rtse dga' spro nus kyang*/ gzhan du bshad dang 'dir mang dogs pa yis/ /nyung 'dus tshig gi gsal bar bkod pa la/ /nongs gang bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod mdzad cing*/ /'dis mtshon dge bas mtha' maid drin can ma/
